#### [3. Awesome Opentofu](/content/virtualroot/awesome-opentofu/README.md)

##### Tools / CI

*   [tofu-garnish (⭐1)](https://github.com/lowlydba/tofu-garnish) - GitHub Action to publish OpenTofu outputs as a static GitHub Pages site.

##### Tools / Platforms

*   [Kumoss (⭐143)](https://github.com/InditexTech/kumoss) - Open-source, self-hosted AI assistant that plugs into your existing Git, LLM and identity stack, turning plain-language day-2 requests into plan-validated OpenTofu pull requests with drift reconciled.

#### [4. Awesome Cli Apps in a Csv](/content/toolleeo/awesome-cli-apps-in-a-csv/README.md)

##### Todo managers

*   [mado (⭐0)](https://github.com/laserattack/mado2) - A command-line organizer for tasks, notes, and other Markdown entries. Each entry lives in its own directory, so it can include attachments alongside MAIN.md. Use queries to filter entries by metadata, then sort and format the results for your editor or scripts.

#### [5. Awesome Zsh Plugins](/content/unixorn/awesome-zsh-plugins/README.md)

##### Plugins / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [Cue (⭐15)](https://github.com/8starlabs/cue) - Adds IDE-style command, option, and path suggestions to ZSH in a native macOS popup.
*   [listview (⭐0)](https://github.com/hanssn/zsh-listview) - Lightweight, zero-dependency ZSH plugin inspired by PowerShell's PSReadLine ListView. Displays real-time, non-intrusive unique history suggestions below your prompt as you type, navigatable using arrow keys.

##### ZSH Tools / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [slowrc (⭐2)](https://github.com/ArkaKhorchidian/slowrc) - Profiles your ZSH startup line by line, shows which lines of your `.zshrc` cost the most, and safely fixes the slow ones.

#### [6. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [nosocial Embed API](https://nosocial.eu/api-docs) - A free API for developers to embed public posts from X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Bluesky, Threads, Facebook, Telegram, Reddit, and LinkedIn on their websites. It returns the embed HTML and any required scripts as JSON. No API key and no request limits.

##### Forms

*   [staticforms.dev](https://www.staticforms.dev/) - Integrate HTML forms easily without any server-side code for free. After the user submits the form, an email with the form content will be sent to your registered address.

##### IaaS

*   [InstaBox](https://instabox.sh/) - Cloud Linux machine for AI agents and developers, running on Firecracker microVMs with Docker and common toolchains preinstalled. Free plan: one 4 vCPU / 8 GiB machine, 20 GiB disk, 5 snapshots and 100 GiB egress per month, no credit card required. Not a persistent VPS: a free machine pauses after 30 minutes idle and runs at most 8 hours per session.

#### [7. Awesome Python](/content/vinta/awesome-python/README.md)

##### Projects / AI and Agents

*   Code Sandboxes
    *   [pydantic-monty (⭐8.8k)](https://github.com/pydantic/monty) - A secure Python sandbox written in Rust for running AI-written code.

##### Projects / Machine Learning

*   Experiment Tracking
    *   [mlflow (⭐29k)](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow) - An open-source platform for tracking experiments, managing models, and evaluating LLM apps.

##### Projects / WebSocket

*   WebRTC
    *   [aiortc (⭐5.1k)](https://github.com/aiortc/aiortc) - A WebRTC and ORTC implementation for asyncio, with audio, video, and data channels.

##### Projects / Testing

*   Benchmarking
    *   [pytest-benchmark (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/ionelmc/pytest-benchmark) - A pytest fixture for benchmarking code.

##### Projects / Debugging Tools

*   Debuggers
    *   [debugpy (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/microsoft/debugpy) - A Debug Adapter Protocol debugger for Python, used by VS Code for remote debugging.
    *   [ipdb (⭐2k)](https://github.com/gotcha/ipdb) - IPython-enabled [pdb](https://docs.python.org/3/library/pdb.html).
    *   [pudb (⭐3.2k)](https://github.com/inducer/pudb) - A full-screen, console-based Python debugger.

##### Projects / File Manipulation

*   Remote Files
    *   [fsspec (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/fsspec/filesystem_spec) - A unified filesystem interface for local, cloud, and remote storage.
    *   [smart-open (⭐3.5k)](https://github.com/piskvorky/smart_open) - Stream files from S3, GCS, Azure, HDFS, and HTTP as a drop-in replacement for open().

##### Projects / Built-in Classes Enhancement

*   Class Boilerplate
    *   [dataclasses](https://docs.python.org/3/library/dataclasses.html) - (Python standard library) Adds generated special methods such as `__init__()` and `__repr__()` to your classes.
    *   [attrs (⭐5.9k)](https://github.com/python-attrs/attrs) - Writes `__init__`, `__eq__`, `__repr__`, and other boilerplate methods for your classes.

##### Projects / Web Security

*   [flask-cors (⭐933)](https://github.com/corydolphin/flask-cors) - A Flask extension for handling Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS).
*   [django-cors-headers (⭐5.6k)](https://github.com/adamchainz/django-cors-headers) - Handles Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) headers for Django apps.

#### [8. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### MCP Servers

*   [KaijuConverter MCP](https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp) - Remote Model Context Protocol server enabling AI agents to convert files and datasets across 100+ formats (documents, images, audio, video). Works with Gemini CLI: `gemini mcp add --transport http kaiju https://kaijuconverter.com/api/mcp`.

#### [9. Awesome Osint](/content/jivoi/awesome-osint/README.md)

##### Other Tools / GitHub

*   [btc-toolkit (⭐3)](https://github.com/devdavidejesus/btc-toolkit) - Command line tool to read Bitcoin on-chain data: decode OP\_RETURN messages and inscriptions, inspect addresses and transactions, and verify a transaction against its block's Merkle proof.

#### [10. Awesome Neovim](/content/rockerBOO/awesome-neovim/README.md)

##### Dependency Management / Quickfix

*   [alessandropietrobelli/nuget.nvim (⭐6)](https://github.com/alessandropietrobelli/nuget.nvim) - NuGet package manager for .NET solutions.

##### Scrolling / Tree-sitter Based

*   [LFSCamargo/macscroll.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/macscroll.nvim) - macOS trackpad and mouse-wheel scrolling delivered by a Darwin handler so terminals cannot drop sideways motion.

#### [11. Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md)

##### Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools [![Awesome List](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-awesome.svg "Awesome List")](https://github.com/BubuAnabelas/awesome-markdown#tools)

*   [Quill](https://quill.hridya.tech) - Markdown editor where Claude Code, Codex or Cursor edits your draft in place, and you keep or revert each change. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/hridaya423/quill) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

##### Developer Tools / Version Control

*   [GitOS](https://gitos.angelsaikia.com/) - Git client that automatically picks the right GitHub account for every repository. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Dhunu/gitOS) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Utilities / Window Management

*   [Show Bar](https://rept0rix.github.io/show-bar/) - Windows-style Command-Tab window switcher with live thumbnails, Dock hover window previews, window snapping, clipboard history, and a screenshot shelf. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/rept0rix/show-bar) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") [![App Store](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-app-store.svg "App Store Software")](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6818509447?platform=mac) ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

#### [12. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md)

##### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [AnalyticsProof](https://analyticsproof.com) - Regression tests for analytics tracking: replays recorded website journeys and reports which step lost a dataLayer event or GA4 parameter. Has a free plan.

#### [1. Awesome Lowcode](/content/antdimot/awesome-lowcode/README.md)

##### Tools / App Vulnerability Scanners

*   [FlutterGuard (⭐34)](https://github.com/anasfik/FlutterGuard) - Offline on-device scanner for released Flutter APKs: manifest policy, libraries, endpoints, exposed strings and dependency clues, with local reports.

##### Tools / Misc Tools

*   [MobShield (⭐13)](https://github.com/Inforaam/MobShield-Android) - Modular, open-source RASP library for Android with weighted, tunable threat scoring for root, hooking frameworks (Frida, Xposed), debuggers, emulators and app tampering. Detect-only by default; no telemetry.

*   [RevoGrid Kanban (⭐10)](https://github.com/revolist/kanban) - Workflow boards, swimlanes, and card editing for the `<revo-grid>` custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
*   [RevoGrid Gantt (⭐10)](https://github.com/revolist/gantt) - Project tasks, dependencies, and Gantt timelines for the `<revo-grid>` custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.
*   [RevoGrid Pivot (⭐10)](https://github.com/revolist/pivot) - Pivot tables and analytical reporting for the `<revo-grid>` custom element. Commercial with a 30-day trial.

#### [4. Discount for Student Dev](/content/AchoArnold/discount-for-student-dev/README.md)

##### SaaS

*   [Remote Frontend Jobs](https://www.remotefrontendjobs.com/junior) \[FREE] - Every remote junior and internship developer job from dozens of job boards in one place, with junior email alerts. Sign up with your school email and Pro is free for 2 months: jobs 24 hours early, daily picks with the reasons they match, and AI search. Also for [backend](https://www.remotebackendjobs.com/junior) and [Java](https://www.remotejavajobs.com/junior).

#### [5. Awesome Selfhosted](/content/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted/README.md)

##### Software / Task Management & To-do Lists

*   [Kept Notes](https://keepitkept.xyz) - A notes app built for quick capture: text notes, checklists, images, drawings, links, attachments, labels, colors, and reminders (alternative to Google Keep). ([Source Code (⭐318)](https://github.com/ericerkz/kept)) `AGPL-3.0/MIT` `Nodejs/Docker`

#### [6. Awesome Acg](/content/soruly/awesome-acg/README.md)

##### Uncategorized

*   [OpenAmika (⭐468)](https://github.com/zeekk0/OpenAmika) - MekaHime's AI companion Amika, open source. Live2D avatar, real-time voice, long-term memory, OpenRouter or Ollama brain. \[English/中文/日本語]

#### [7. Awesome Integration](/content/stn1slv/awesome-integration/README.md)

##### Projects / Managed File Transfer

*   [Titan MFT Server](https://southrivertech.com/titan-mft-server) - Enterprise-level MFT server offering high availability, failover capabilities, and efficient large-scale file automation.

##### Projects / Messaging as a Service

*   [Oracle Cloud Streaming](https://www.oracle.com/cloud/streaming/) - Serverless, real-time event streaming platform with Apache Kafka compatibility for efficient data processing.

##### Resources / Protocols

*   [CoAP](https://coap.space/) - A specialized application protocol designed for constrained devices in the Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem. CoAP offers a lightweight, low-overhead communication mechanism to support resource-constrained devices.

#### [8. ALL About RSS](/content/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/README.md)

##### 🔍 Feed Search Engines / 酷Q Plugin

*   [Offline Web Search](https://f-droid.org/en/packages/io.github.rumcajs.offlinewebsearch/) : searches a bundled offline catalogue of 56,000+ RSS and Atom feed URLs, with swappable SQLite indexes and no network queries [![Android](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/android.png)](https://f-droid.org/en/packages/io.github.rumcajs.offlinewebsearch/)[![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/rumca-js/OfflineWebSearch)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

##### specifically from (*a certain platform*) / Bluesky

*   [FxEmbed](https://docs.fxembed.com/guide/advanced/rss-atom-feeds/) : generates RSS 2.0 and Atom feeds for Bluesky profiles, with media-only variants and a configurable item count [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/FxEmbed/FxEmbed)![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)

##### RSS2Podcast / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [rss-pod (⭐42)](https://github.com/synrise25/rss-pod): Self-hosted tool that turns RSS articles into multi-speaker conversational podcasts using LLMs and TTS, with scheduled generation and podcast RSS output. [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/synrise25/rss-pod)![AI](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-ai-16.png)

##### Combine multiple feeds into one / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed [1264](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1264)

*   [rssrssrssrss](https://www.rssrssrssrss.com/) <sup>[1521](https://t.me/s/aboutrss/1521)</sup> : merge multiple RSS feeds into one without an account, with the feed list encoded into the permalink ![Online](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-web-design-16.png)![Freeware](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/icons8-one-free-16.png)

#### [9. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### Security and PKI

*   [Topscan.me](https://topscan.me/free-plan) - SaaS vulnerability scanning platform. Free: a full infrastructure scan of one host every week, Discovery and Attack Surface for everything around it, one repository, one user, findings with a fix and a Security Score.

##### PaaS

*   [Uppcoder](https://portal.uppcoder.com/) - Full stack development environment hosted on own infrastructure with selectable framework, db engine behind https with ssh access, vscode + terminal in the editor. Free tier: always on, 2GB disk and 2GB ram. No card required.

##### Payment and Billing Integration

*   [BillDog.io](https://billdog.io/)  - In-app subscription paywalls, A/B testing, product analytics, and messaging with SDKs for iOS, Android, React Native, Flutter, Unity, and web. Free up to $3k/mo in tracked revenue and 1M monthly analytics events.

#### [10. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Orchestrator](https://orchestrator.inc?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Open-source desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux) that runs Gemini CLI alongside Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents as parallel workers, each in its own git worktree, with an orchestrator agent splitting the work and a board tracking every PR through CI and review.

##### Development Tools & Utilities

*   [AI Meter (⭐4)](https://github.com/dichiara19/ai-meter) - Native Windows 11 app that lists active Gemini CLI sessions, on Windows and in WSL, with their model and context in use, next to Google Antigravity quotas and other AI usage limits in a taskbar pill.
*   [AI Usage Meter (VS Code) (⭐2)](https://github.com/theluckystrike/ai-usage-meter-vscode) - VS Code extension that reads Gemini CLI session files in `~/.gemini/tmp` and shows today's tokens and estimated cost in the status bar, with a dashboard split by project and model. Also covers Claude Code and Codex. Runs offline, no login or API key.

##### MCP Servers

*   [Sequenzy (⭐3)](https://github.com/Sequenzy/mcp) - Hosted MCP server for Sequenzy, an email marketing platform for SaaS and ecommerce: manage subscribers, lists, tags and segments, build campaigns, sequences and templates, send transactional email, run A/B tests and read delivery stats from Gemini CLI. About 420 tools, each annotated read-only or destructive. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in (an API key also works); free plan with 2,500 emails/month. MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Sequenzy/mcp`, then `/mcp auth sequenzy`. Local stdio alternative: `npx -y @sequenzy/mcp` with `SEQUENZY_API_KEY`.
*   [Imagera (⭐2)](https://github.com/alexadams6ix/imagera-skills) - Remote MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for image, video, voice and music generation and editing (OAuth sign-in, no API key), with 37 skills and the credit cost stated before each run. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/alexadams6ix/imagera-skills`
*   [Vicem (⭐7)](https://github.com/RAKKUNN/vicem) - Zero-dependency MCP server and CLI that harvests live coding sessions (Gemini CLI chats and `GEMINI.md`, plus Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 15+ agents), scores context salience (`0–100%`), skeletonizes code by 80–90% into a local SHA-256 ledger (`.vicem/ledger.json`) for lossless on-demand `vicem_rehydrate`, and writes a portable `.vicem/BATON.md` handoff. Runs locally with zero network calls. MIT. Add with `gemini mcp add vicem npx -y vicem-cli mcp`.
*   [LinkJolt (⭐2)](https://github.com/Efesop/linkjolt-mcp-server) - Set up and run an affiliate program for your SaaS from Gemini CLI: plan a commission from published benchmarks, create campaigns, add and check tracking for Stripe, Paddle, Polar or Creem, invite affiliates, approve affiliates and sales, and see who you owe. 28 tools; it can't move money. Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in; needs a LinkJolt account (7-day free trial). MIT. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Efesop/linkjolt-mcp-server`, then `/mcp auth linkjolt`.
*   [GSC PAP (⭐2)](https://github.com/aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin) - Hosted, read-only MCP server and Gemini CLI extension for your own Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, PageSpeed Insights and Chrome UX Report data, plus live Google results. Sign in with Google on first use; it keeps a Search Console archive past Google's 16-month limit. Free. Install: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/aliarifsoydas/gsc-pap-claude-plugin`
*   [gemini-pro-mcp (⭐4)](https://github.com/Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp) - MCP server that brings a Google AI Pro subscription to Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex and the Antigravity CLI: Gemini through the Antigravity CLI on the plan's limits (no API bill), Deep Research, Google Flow videos of any length, Gemini Notebooks (Audio Overviews), AI Mode and Jules, plus Nano Banana images and Omni Flash video through the Gemini API. `gemini-pro-mcp setup` registers it with Gemini CLI and the other clients in one command, and `doctor` checks what works. MIT. Install: `uvx --from git+https://github.com/Muzaqil555/gemini-pro-mcp gemini-pro-mcp setup`.

#### [11. Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md)

##### Reading and Writing Tools / Note-taking

*   [Knovum (⭐34)](https://github.com/madebyzan/knovum) - Local-first 2D spatial AI knowledge space with embedded LanceDB vector search, infinite canvas, and on-device Whisper transcription. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/madebyzan/knovum) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

#### [12. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md)

##### Software / Security Testing

*   [appfuzz (⭐2)](https://github.com/StephanSchmidt/appfuzz) - Fuzzes WebAssembly apps against a simulated backend and reports crashes, injection, n+1 queries and data leaks, with an exit code for CI.

##### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [ScopeHaven (⭐1)](https://github.com/YusefSyed/scopehaven-oss) - Runs an AI agent's tasks against a local copy of your app, as different users, and checks whether "done" matches what the app's records show. Node CLI and GitHub Action, Apache-2.0.

#### [1. Awesome Mqtt](/content/awesome-mqtt/awesome-mqtt/README.md)

##### Tools

*   [LibreDB Studio (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/libredb/libredb-studio) - Open source web database IDE with a read-only MQTT 5.0 connection: browse a broker's live topic tree with retained messages and read topics, including Sparkplug B payloads.
*   [MQTTProbe (⭐41)](https://github.com/bluegrassiot/mqttprobe) - Cross platform MQTT diagnostic client for IIoT with live topic browsing, payload decoding across multiple formats, charting, built in emulators, and advanced Sparkplug B integration.
*   [TrailTransfer (⭐0)](https://github.com/RainerGewalt/trailtransfer) - MQTT-controlled rclone worker for edge file transfers with a local policy and a hash-chained, independently verifiable evidence journal.

#### [2. Awesome Zsh Plugins](/content/unixorn/awesome-zsh-plugins/README.md)

##### ZSH Tools / [superconsole](https://github.com/alexchmykhalo/superconsole) - Windows-only

*   [speedrunner (⭐3)](https://github.com/anthonyGosme/speedrunner) - Speeds up the start of Python, Ruby, PHP and Node CLIs by forking them from a preloaded daemon. Its ZSH hook starts the daemon while you type the command name.

#### [3. Awesome Docker](/content/veggiemonk/awesome-docker/README.md)

##### Where to Start / Wrappers

*   [prepare.sh Docker Course](https://prepare.sh/course/docker-course) - :yen: Learn Docker in nine hands-on chapters that each run in a live Linux VM in the browser, from a first container to multi-stage builds, registries, volumes, networking, and image CVE scanning.

##### Security Articles / Wrappers

*   [Privileged Containers Exercise](https://ransomleak.com/exercises/privileged-containers/) - Escape a privileged Docker container to the host in the browser, then fix it with a non-root user, dropped capabilities, and a read-only rootfs.

#### [4. Awesome Cl](/content/CodyReichert/awesome-cl/README.md)

##### Agents

*   [nodecode (⭐176)](https://github.com/nodecode-ai/nodecode) - a living agent organism in Lisp. It becomes yours and evolves over time. MIT.

##### Graph databases

*   [Ariadne (⭐1)](https://github.com/hajovonta/ariadne) - A graph database in Common Lisp with full W3C SPARQL 1.1 and SHACL conformance, Gremlin-style traversal, RDF import/export, property graph support, inference rules, graph analytics, and Graphviz visualization.
    *   *Built with LLMs*.

#### [5. Tools](/content/lvwzhen/tools/README.md)

##### Tools collection

*   [DevToolbox](https://dev-toolbox.io/) - 30 free developer tools: JSON formatter and diff, regex tester, JWT decoder, Base64, hashing, cron parser, YAML and CSV converters. Everything runs client-side, no sign-up.

#### [6. Awesome Developer First](/content/agamm/awesome-developer-first/README.md)

##### Messaging

*   [SuprSend](https://www.suprsend.com) - Notification infrastructure with workflows, templates and preferences for email, SMS, push, in-app and chat.

#### [7. Awesome Deno](/content/denolib/awesome-deno/README.md)

##### Modules / Cloud APIs

*   [sigflint (⭐2)](https://github.com/bompus/sigflint) - AWS Signature Version 4 and SigV4a request signing with no dependencies, for use with `fetch`.

##### Showcases / XML

*   [globnotes (⭐6)](https://github.com/alexindigo/globnotes) - Self-hosted Markdown note-taking app for Obsidian vaults and nested folders, with full-text search and sandboxed plugins.

#### [8. Awesome Privacy](/content/pluja/awesome-privacy/README.md)

##### VPNs / Apps

*   **Free VPNs**: a 2017 study of 283 Android VPN apps found 75% used trackers and 38% contained malware. <sub>[Source](https://torrentfreak.com/researchers-issue-security-warning-over-android-vpn-apps-170125/)</sub>

##### Password Managers / Useful Tools

*   **LastPass**: the UK fined it £1.2 million in 2025 over a 2022 breach that leaked customers' encrypted vaults. <sub>[Source](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/uk-fines-lastpass-over-2022-data-breach-impacting-16-million-users/)</sub>

##### Encryption / Useful Tools

*   **BitLocker**: your recovery key is uploaded to Microsoft by default, and Microsoft has handed such keys to the FBI. <sub>[Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/01/23/microsoft-gave-fbi-a-set-of-bitlocker-encryption-keys-to-unlock-suspects-laptops-reports)</sub>

##### Photo Editing and Management / Deezer alternative clients

*   **Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom**: its 2024 terms say Adobe may access your cloud content through both automated and manual review. <sub>[Source](https://www.theregister.com/2024/06/06/adobe_users_upset_over_content/)</sub>

##### Video Editing / Deezer alternative clients

*   **Adobe Premiere Pro**: its terms allow automated scanning of your Creative Cloud files and human review of flagged ones. <sub>[Source](https://www.adobe.com/legal/terms.html)</sub>

##### Ebooks / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **Amazon Kindle**: in 2009 Amazon remotely deleted copies of 1984 that people had bought from their Kindles. <sub>[Source](https://www.theregister.com/2009/07/18/amazon_removes_1984_from_kindle/)</sub>

##### Android Debloat Tools / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **ADB AppControl**: its terms let it send your PC's IP, hardware details and the apps you remove to a remote server. <sub>[Source](https://appcontrol.neocities.org/pages/terms_of_use)</sub>

##### Android Gallery / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **Google Photos**: scans your photos, and in 2022 its scan got a father investigated by police over photos taken for a doctor. <sub>[Source](https://gizmodo.com/google-csam-photodna-1849440471)</sub>

##### Home Assistants / Other OS

*   **Siri**: in 2025 Apple settled claims that Siri recorded private conversations without consent for $95 million. <sub>[Source](https://scott-scott.com/court-grants-final-approval-of-95m-apple-siri-settlement/)</sub>

##### Payments / Apps and services

*   **Visa / Mastercard**: your card purchases feed Mastercard audience segments, like affluent shoppers, sold on data marketplaces. <sub>[Source](https://www.americanbanker.com/news/mastercard-removes-some-ads-for-customer-transaction-data)</sub>

##### Legend / Apps and services

*   `⚠️ closed server`: the server code isn't public.
*   `⚠️ account required`: an account is needed to use it.

  • pando (⭐7) - Terminal workspace that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and shells, each session in its own git worktree, under a daemon that keeps them running when the TUI closes. Marks a Gemini session running or waiting for approval, reviews and commits its diff in the TUI, and has a CLI that blocks on session status.

Commands & Extensions

  • Log10x (⭐2) - Gemini CLI extension that installs the log10x MCP server (MIT, local stdio). It ranks log patterns by volume and cost and plans an action for the excess over each cap: compact on Splunk and self-managed Elasticsearch, tier down or offload to S3 on other platforms. No log data reaches log10x. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/log-10x/log10x-plugin.

MCP Servers

  • Candor Finance - Personal finance for Gemini CLI from your own US bank, card, loan, and investment accounts: spending, cash flow, a budget, and goals with a target, a date, and a monthly amount, saved across sessions, plus a weekly review that tells Gemini what is worth talking through. Bank access is read-only and no tool moves money. Hosted MCP server with OAuth sign-in plus 10 agent skills; requires a Candor account. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/candorsystems/candor-finance, then /mcp auth candor.

20. Awesome Neovim

Editing Support / Scrollbar

  • LongYinStudio/suda.nvim (⭐3) - Transparent, "sudo-like" privilege elevation without virtual URI hacks.

21. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Writing

  • Drifting - Open-source, local-first novel writing app with chapters, outline, characters and storylines, and an AI agent that can read and edit the whole project.

Reading and Writing Tools / Others

  • Saywing - Open-source tool that reads selected screen regions aloud using local OCR and neural speech, with offline English and German dictation.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Flipic (⭐6) - Photo culling viewer: arrow-key paging through a folder, 100% focus check, XMP ratings that Lightroom and Capture One read, on-device cleanup mode.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • Radif - Unofficial open-source YouTube Music client built with Tauri, with synced lyrics and a video mode, that needs YouTube Music Premium.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • Wavo (⭐10) - Dictation that doesn't slow your Mac down: it runs on the Neural Engine, keeps your voice off the cloud, and types what you say wherever you're typing.

22. Awesome Rust

Applications / Database

  • xerj-org/xerj (⭐19k) - Search engine for AI agents in one binary: BM25, vector and hybrid search over an Elasticsearch-compatible API, with a built-in MCP server

Applications / Web Servers

  • inbjo/MirrorProxy (⭐310) - A self-hosted caching proxy for package registries, container images, and source downloads, with a web console and cross-platform CLI.

23. Awesome Testing

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • evalship - GitHub App that finds flaws in your LLM evals, says on every pull request which evals a change broke and why, and finds prompt and model changes that win beyond chance.

items.content_text:
#### [1. Awesome Privacy](/content/pluja/awesome-privacy/README.md)

##### Medical health / Apps and services

*   **[MedTimer (⭐648)](https://github.com/Futsch1/medTimer)** - Medication reminder that keeps all data on the device and has no internet permission. <sub>Android · MIT · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.futsch1.medtimer/)</sub>

##### Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

*   **WhatsApp**: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/198) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-whatsapp-inquiry)</sub>
*   **Zoom**: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2198) · [Source](https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/01/zoom-reaches-85-million-settlement-over-user-privacy-and-hacker-zoombombing.html)</sub>
*   **[BigBlueButton](https://bigbluebutton.org/)** - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host · LGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Briefing](https://brie.fi/ng)** - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Chitchatter](https://chitchatter.im/)** - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>
*   **[Jami](https://jami.net/)** - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. <sub>GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/cx.ring/)</sub>
*   **[Jitsi Meet](https://jitsi.org/jitsi-meet/)** - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. <sub>self-host · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.jitsi.meet/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **[MiroTalk P2P](https://p2p.mirotalk.com/)** - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mumble](https://www.mumble.info/)** - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. <sub>self-host</sub>

##### Instant Messaging

*   **Facebook Messenger**: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/182) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.facebook.orca/latest/) · [Source](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2023/12/meta-announces-end-end-encryption-default-messenger)</sub>

##### Instagram / Desktop

*   **Instagram**: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/219) · [Source](https://www.dataprotection.ie/en/news-media/press-releases/data-protection-commission-announces-decision-instagram-inquiry)</sub>
*   **[Pixelfed](https://pixelfed.org/)** - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Location Tracking / Apps and services

*   **Google Find Hub (formerly Find My Device)**: reports your devices' locations to Google. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/217)</sub>

##### Teamworking Tools / Desktop

*   **[Wire](https://wire.com/)** - End-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and file sharing for teams, with public and audited code for both the apps and the server. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>AGPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.wire/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **Discord**: a 2025 breach at a support vendor exposed government ID photos of about 70,000 users. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/536) · [Source](https://discord.com/press-releases/update-on-security-incident-involving-third-party-customer-service)</sub>
*   **Slack**: your messages feed its recommendation models unless a workspace owner emails Slack to opt out. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/206) · [Source](https://slack.com/trust/data-management/privacy-principles)</sub>
*   **[Rocket.Chat](https://www.rocket.chat/)** - Self-hosted team chat with end-to-end encrypted rooms and federation. `⚠️ website trackers` <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[Twake Chat](https://twake.app/)** - Workplace chat built on Matrix, part of Linagora's Twake Workplace suite. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Maps and Navigation / Apps and services

*   **Bing Maps**: under Microsoft's very poorly rated privacy policy. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/244)</sub>
*   **Yandex Maps**: 11 trackers in its Android app, from a company bound by Russian surveillance law. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/ru.yandex.yandexmaps/latest/)</sub>
*   **Sygic**: 8 trackers in its Android app. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.sygic.aura/latest/)</sub>
*   **[OpenStreetMap (OSM)](https://www.openstreetmap.org/)** - Collaborative world map built by volunteers, and the open data behind most apps in this section. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>
    *   **[OsmAnd](https://osmand.net/)** - Offline maps and navigation built on OpenStreetMap, with a large set of features. `⚠️ telemetry opt-out` <sub>Android · iOS · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/net.osmand.plus/)</sub>
*   **[Pure Maps](https://rinigus.github.io/pure-maps/)** - Maps and navigation for Linux phones, Sailfish OS and desktop, fully offline with OSM Scout Server. <sub>Linux · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Search Engines / Useful Tools

*   **Yahoo!**: a 2013 breach hit all 3 billion Yahoo accounts, which Yahoo admitted only in 2017. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/309) · [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2017/10/03/yahoo-says-all-3b-accounts-were-impacted-by-2013-breach-not-1b-as-thought)</sub>
*   **Yandex**: in 2025 researchers found its Android apps, Yandex Search among them, secretly linked browsing to device IDs. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/860) · [Source](https://localmess.github.io/)</sub>
*   **[Brave Search](https://search.brave.com)** - Search engine with [its own independent index](https://brave.com/search-independence/), from the makers of Brave.
*   **[DuckDuckGo](https://duckduckgo.com)** - Search engine that doesn't build a profile on you, with results drawn largely from Bing.
*   **[Marginalia](https://marginalia-search.com/)** - Independent search engine with its own crawler and index that favors text-heavy, non-commercial pages. <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[Mojeek](https://www.mojeek.com/)** - UK search engine with its own crawler and index and a no-tracking policy.
*   **[Qwant](https://www.qwant.com/)** - French search engine, hosted in the EU, that doesn't track your searches.
*   **[SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org/)** - Metasearch engine that queries other search services for you; use a [public instance](https://searx.space/) or host your own. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[YaCy](https://yacy.net/)** - Peer-to-peer search engine where every user runs a node and shares the index.

##### Third-party

*   **[Proton Mail](https://proton.me/mail)** - Email from Switzerland, end-to-end encrypted between Proton users and with PGP, and stored encrypted otherwise, where a court order can still force it to log your IP ([2021 case](https://proton.me/blog/climate-activist-arrest)). <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Self-hosted

*   **[Docker Mailserver](https://docker-mailserver.github.io/docker-mailserver/latest/)** - Complete mail server (SMTP, IMAP, antispam, antivirus) in a single Docker container, configured with files. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>
*   **[Mail-in-a-box](https://mailinabox.email/)** - Turns a fresh Ubuntu server into a complete mail server with one setup script. <sub>self-host · CC0-1.0</sub>
*   **[Mailcow: dockerized](https://mailcow.email)** - Docker-based mail server suite with a web admin panel, webmail and groupware. <sub>self-host · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mox](https://www.xmox.nl)** - Self-contained mail server in a single binary, built to need little maintenance. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

##### Clients / Android / iOS

*   **[FairEmail](https://email.faircode.eu/)** - Full-featured email app that blocks tracking images and keeps everything on your device. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/eu.faircode.email/)</sub>
*   **[Thunderbird for Android](https://www.thunderbird.net/en-US/mobile/)** - Mozilla's email app for Android, built on K-9 Mail, which still ships from the same code. <sub>Android · Apache-2.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/net.thunderbird.android/)</sub>

##### Clients / Desktop

*   **[NeoMutt](https://neomutt.org/)** - Terminal email client with built-in PGP/GPG support, a maintained fork of Mutt. <sub>Linux · macOS · CLI · GPL-2.0</sub>

##### Email Alias Services (Anonymous Forwarding) / Desktop

*   **[addy.io](https://addy.io)** - Email alias and forwarding service you can host yourself, formerly AnonAddy. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[SimpleLogin](https://simplelogin.io)** - Email alias service you can host yourself, owned by Proton. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Alternative clients/modifications of Discord / Desktop

*   **[Aliucord (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/Aliucord/Aliucord)** - Mod for the Android Discord app that [disables Discord's tracking (⭐4.9k)](https://github.com/Aliucord/Aliucord/blob/main/Aliucord/src/main/java/com/aliucord/coreplugins/NoTrack.java). <sub>Android · OSL-3.0</sub>
*   **[BetterDiscord](https://betterdiscord.app/)** - Discord client mod; add the [DoNotTrack](https://betterdiscord.app/plugins/DoNotTrack) plugin to block trackers. <sub>Apache-2.0</sub>
*   **[Legcord](https://legcord.app)** - Lightweight Discord client that blocks Discord's known trackers by default, formerly ArmCord. <sub>OSL-3.0</sub>
*   **[OpenAsar](https://openasar.dev/)** - Drop-in replacement for part of the Discord desktop app, with a [No Tracking (⭐3k)](https://github.com/GooseMod/OpenAsar#readme) option that turns off crash and error reporting. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Replugged](https://replugged.dev/)** - Discord client mod that continues the discontinued Powercord. <sub>MIT</sub>
*   **[Vencord](https://vencord.dev)** - Discord client mod with plugins, including one that blocks Discord's tracking. <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Vesktop](https://vesktop.dev/)** - Desktop Discord client with Vencord built in, which blocks Discord's telemetry. <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[WebCord (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/SpacingBat3/WebCord)** - Discord client that loads the web app in Electron instead of using the Discord API, with extra privacy settings. <sub>MIT</sub>

##### Blogging platforms (Medium) / Desktop

*   **Medium**: the site carries trackers, under a poorly rated privacy policy. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/1003)</sub>
*   **[Plume](https://joinplu.me/)** - Federated blogging engine where readers can follow and comment from any ActivityPub account. `💀 inactive` <sub>ActivityPub</sub>
*   **[WriteFreely](https://writefreely.org/)** - Minimal, distraction-free blogging platform that can federate posts over ActivityPub. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### YouTube / Desktop

*   **YouTube**: Google paid a record $170 million in 2019 for collecting children's data on YouTube without parental consent. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/274) · [Source](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2019/09/google-youtube-will-pay-record-170-million-alleged-violations-childrens-privacy-law)</sub>
*   **[PeerTube](https://joinpeertube.org/en/)** - Federated video hosting where anyone can run an instance and follow channels across others. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### YouTube / Frontends

*   **[Invidious](https://invidious.io/)** - YouTube frontend with no ads or Google scripts and subscriptions without an account; see the [public instances](https://docs.invidious.io/instances/). <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[youtube-local (⭐779)](https://github.com/user234683/youtube-local)** - YouTube client that runs on your computer and opens in the browser, with local subscriptions and optional routing through Tor. <sub>Desktop · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### YouTube / Apps

*   **[FreeTube](https://freetubeapp.io/)** - Desktop YouTube app that keeps subscriptions, playlists and history on your computer, without Google's cookies or scripts. <sub>Desktop · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[LibreTube](https://libretube.dev/)** - Android YouTube app that fetches videos through Piped instead of Google's servers. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.github.libretube/)</sub>
*   **[NewPipe](https://newpipe.net/)** - Lightweight Android YouTube app with background play and downloads, no Google services or account needed. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.schabi.newpipe/)</sub>
*   **[SkyTube (⭐2.8k)](https://github.com/SkyTubeTeam/SkyTube)** - Android YouTube app with local subscriptions, downloads and a channel and video blocker. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/free.rm.skytube.oss/)</sub>
*   **[Yattee (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/yattee/yattee)** - Native YouTube player for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Mac that works through Invidious or Piped. <sub>iOS · macOS · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Twitter / Apps

*   **Twitter (X)**: paid $150 million in 2022 for using phone numbers given for account security to target ads. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/195) · [Source](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2022/05/ftc-charges-twitter-deceptively-using-account-security-data-sell-targeted-ads)</sub>

##### Twitter / Decentralized

*   **[Mastodon](https://joinmastodon.org/)** - Federated microblogging, the largest network in the fediverse. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.joinmastodon.android/)</sub>
    *   **[Mastodon Apps](https://joinmastodon.org/apps)** - Official directory of Mastodon apps for Android, iOS, web and desktop.
*   **[Pleroma](https://git.pleroma.social/pleroma/pleroma)** - Lightweight federated social network server. <sub>ActivityPub</sub>
    *   **[Soapbox](https://gitlab.com/soapbox-pub/soapbox-fe)** - Web frontend for Pleroma focused on custom branding and ease of use.

##### Twitter / Frontends

*   **[Nitter (⭐14k)](https://github.com/zedeus/nitter)** - Twitter frontend without JavaScript or ads that proxies every request; see the [instances list (⭐14k)](https://github.com/zedeus/nitter/wiki/Instances). `💀 inactive` <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Squawker (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/j-fbriere/squawker)** - Android Twitter client with no account, tracking or ads, keeping subscriptions on the device; the maintained fork of Fritter. <sub>Android · MIT · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/org.ca.squawker/)</sub>

##### Reddit / Frontends

*   **Reddit**: sold Google the right to train AI on users' posts in a 2024 deal valued at about $60 million. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/194) · [Source](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/google-reddit-60-million-deal-ai-training/)</sub>

##### Reddit / Alternatives

*   **[Lemmy](https://join-lemmy.org/)** - Federated link aggregator and discussion forum, organized into communities like subreddits. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Mbin](https://joinmbin.org/)** - Federated link aggregator with microblogging, the community-run continuation of kbin. <sub>ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Streaming Platforms (Twitch) / Apps and frontends

*   **Twitch**: a 2021 breach leaked 125GB of its data, including source code and three years of creator payouts. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/200) · [Source](https://fortune.com/2021/10/06/twitch-data-leak-hack-source-code-creator-payouts-4chan/)</sub>
*   **[Owncast](https://owncast.online/)** - Self-hosted live streaming server with built-in chat, so you own the stream and your viewers' data. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

##### Streaming Platforms (Twitch) / Apps

*   **[Twire (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/twireapp/Twire)** - Android Twitch client with built-in ad blocking, VODs with chat replay, and optional login. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.perflyst.twire/)</sub>

##### Imgur / Apps

*   **Imgur**: a 2014 hack stole about 1.7 million email addresses and passwords, which it only learned of in 2017. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/325) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.imgur.mobile/latest/) · [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2017/11/27/imgur-says-1-7m-emails-and-passwords-were-breached-in-2014-hack/)</sub>
*   **[rimgo](https://codeberg.org/rimgo/rimgo)** - Read-only Imgur frontend that works without JavaScript; see the [instances](https://rimgo.codeberg.page/).

##### IMDb / Apps

*   **IMDb**: owned by Amazon, with 8 trackers in its Android app. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/313) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.imdb.mobile/latest/)</sub>
*   **[libremdb (⭐441)](https://github.com/zyachel/libremdb)** - IMDb frontend without ads or tracking that proxies images and video through the instance. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Fandom / Apps

*   **Fandom**: wikis loaded with ads and autoplaying video, and 8 trackers in the app. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2256) · [Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.fandom.app/latest/)</sub>

##### Commenting Engines / Apps

*   **Disqus**: tracked visitors across sites for ad profiling without consent, Norway's regulator said in 2021. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/239) · [Source](https://www.datatilsynet.no/en/news/2021/intent-to-issue--25-million-fine-to-disqus-inc/)</sub>
*   **[Isso](https://isso-comments.de)** - Lightweight self-hosted comment server, meant as a drop-in replacement for Disqus. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

##### Translation / Apps

*   **DeepL**: the free version may train on your texts, and its terms forbid entering any personal data. <sub>[ToS;DR](https://tosdr.org/en/service/2073) · [Source](https://www.deepl.com/en/terms-of-use)</sub>

##### Text translation / Apps

*   **[LibreTranslate](https://libretranslate.com/)** - Self-hosted machine translation API and web app with no ties to proprietary services. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Alternative Google Translate frontends / Apps

*   **[Mozhi](https://codeberg.org/aryak/mozhi)** - Frontend that proxies Google Translate, DeepL, Yandex and other engines behind one interface. <sub>self-host</sub>
*   **[SimplyTranslate](https://simplytranslate.org/)** - Frontend that proxies your requests to Google Translate and other engines. <sub>self-host</sub>

##### RSS Readers / Apps

*   **[Capy Reader (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/jocmp/capyreader)** - Small RSS reader, local or synced with Miniflux and FreshRSS. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0 · [F-Droid](https://f-droid.org/packages/com.capyreader.app/) (Play Store version has trackers)</sub>
*   **[Feeder (⭐3.1k)](https://github.com/spacecowboy/Feeder)** - RSS reader that fetches feeds directly on your device, with no account. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Fluent Reader (⭐9.8k)](https://github.com/yang991178/fluent-reader)** - Desktop RSS reader that keeps your feeds locally, with optional sync to self-hosted services. <sub>Linux · Windows · macOS · BSD-3-Clause</sub>
*   **[FreshRSS](https://freshrss.org/)** - Self-hosted feed aggregator with a web interface, multi-user support and an API for mobile apps. <sub>self-host · AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Miniflux](https://miniflux.app/)** - Minimalist self-hosted feed reader with no tracking, written in Go. <sub>self-host · Apache-2.0</sub>
*   **[NetNewsWire](https://netnewswire.com/)** - RSS reader for Mac, iPhone and iPad that works locally or syncs with self-hosted services. <sub>macOS · iOS · MIT</sub>
*   **[Newsboat](https://newsboat.org/)** - RSS reader for the terminal, configured with plain text files. <sub>Linux · macOS · CLI · MIT</sub>
*   **[NewsFlash](https://gitlab.com/news-flash/news_flash_gtk)** - RSS reader for Linux that works locally or with self-hosted services such as Miniflux and FreshRSS. <sub>Linux · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Read You (⭐7.6k)](https://github.com/ReadYouApp/ReadYou)** - Material You RSS reader, local or synced with self-hosted services. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### VPNs / Apps

*   **[SPN](https://safing.io/spn/)** - Paid add-on to the Portmaster firewall that routes each app's connections over separate multi-hop paths. <sub>Linux · Windows · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Web Browser / Apps

*   **Opera**: 6 trackers in its Android app, and owned by a Chinese consortium since 2016. <sub>[Exodus](https://reports.exodus-privacy.eu.org/en/reports/com.opera.browser/latest/) · [Source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Opera_\(web_browser\))</sub>

##### Android / iOS / Apps

*   **[Cromite (⭐8.5k)](https://github.com/uazo/cromite)** - Chromium fork, successor to Bromite, with built-in ad blocking and anti-fingerprinting measures. <sub>Android · Linux · Windows · GPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Firefox](https://www.firefox.com/en-US/mobile/)** - Mozilla's browser, with its own engine on Android and Enhanced Tracking Protection on by default. `⚠️ website trackers` `⚠️ telemetry opt-out`
    *   **[IronFox](https://gitlab.com/ironfox-oss/IronFox)** - Hardened Firefox for Android with proprietary blobs removed, a fork of the discontinued Mull. <sub>Android</sub>

##### Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

*   Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
*   Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
*   Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

##### Legend / Apps and services

*   `💀 inactive`: development has stalled. It still works and has no maintained alternative, so check before relying on it.
*   `⚠️ closed source`: the code isn't public. Listed only because of a long, trusted record.
*   `⚠️ source-available`: the code is public, but the license isn't an open source one.
*   `⚠️ website trackers`: the project's website loads third-party trackers. That says nothing about the app itself.
*   `⚠️ telemetry opt-out`: the app sends usage data by default, but a setting turns it off.

WorldTimeAPI-compatible endpoints for apps that used worldtimeapi.org. Free plan includes 10,000 requests/month on all endpoints.

##### Monitoring

##### Analytics, Events and Statistics

##### Programming Languages Support / Markdown and LaTeX

*   [ywsrock/nvim-md-preview (⭐2)](https://github.com/ywsrock/nvim-md-preview) - Markdown preview in your browser with two-way cursor sync, Mermaid and KaTeX support, and PDF/DOCX/HTML/EPUB export.

##### Utility / Cursorline

*   [alexcloudstar/cheatsheet.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/alexcloudstar/cheatsheet.nvim) - Telescope cheatsheet for your keybindings; look up a key by task or keyword and add your own keys.

##### Formatting / Folding

*   [javanoo6/intellij-formatter.nvim (⭐1)](https://github.com/javanoo6/intellij-formatter.nvim) - IntelliJ-powered formatting through conform.nvim, with EditorConfig support, Java import cleanup, and a reusable daemon.

#### [17. Awesome Mac](/content/jaywcjlove/awesome-mac/README.md)

##### Terminal Apps / Databases

*   [SSHTermaq](https://f1resh.github.io/sshtermaq/) - PuTTY-compatible SSH, Telnet and serial terminal with tabs, split panes, an SFTP/SCP file manager and one-click PuTTY session import. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/f1resh/sshtermaq) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/tancheng33/tingo) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Utilities / Productivity

*   [Ferrocast](https://ferrocast.app) - Fast keyboard launcher written in Rust, with clipboard history, snippets, window management and 275 local file conversions. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/drumst0ck/ferrocast) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Utilities / Window Management

*   [LumaRing (⭐82)](https://github.com/potatoQi/LumaRing) - Radial menu for switching apps, windows, and browser tabs. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/potatoQi/LumaRing) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

#### [18. Awesome Rust](/content/rust-unofficial/awesome-rust/README.md)

##### Applications / Text editors

*   [sventmueller/splat (⭐4)](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat) - An ultrafast native Markdown editor for macOS on AppKit, no Electron. Edits in the preview leave untouched lines byte-for-byte identical, so Git diffs stay clean. LaTeX and Mermaid offline, 35 languages. [![build badge](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/sventmueller/splat/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

#### [19. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md)

##### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [llmdrill (⭐0)](https://github.com/hamarshehmhmd/llmdrill) - Open-source CLI that runs your app behind a local fake of the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, injects outages (529/503 overloads, 429 with retry-after, hangs, cut streams) and grades its retries, backoff, timeouts and failover.

##### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [GenClass (⭐7)](https://github.com/genclass-dev/GenClass) - Open-source browser library that reports race conditions in a web app while they happen (stale responses written over newer data, duplicate submits, failure storms) with a small on-device model. Its local MCP server re-runs a page with responses delivered in different orders to find races and replays one order to prove a fix.
*   [Replay QA](https://replay.io/) - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.
items.content_html:
1. Awesome Privacy

Medical health / Apps and services

  • MedTimer (⭐648) - Medication reminder that keeps all data on the device and has no internet permission. Android · MIT · F-Droid

Video and Audio Conferencing / Desktop

  • WhatsApp: in 2021 Ireland fined it €225 million for not properly explaining what data it shares with Facebook. ToS;DR · Source
  • Zoom: paid $85 million in 2021 to settle claims it shared user data with Facebook, Google and LinkedIn. ToS;DR · Source
  • BigBlueButton - Self-hosted web conferencing built for online classes, with whiteboard, breakout rooms and recordings. ⚠️ website trackers self-host · LGPL-3.0
  • Briefing - Group video chat in the browser over direct WebRTC connections, with no account. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Chitchatter - Serverless, ephemeral peer-to-peer chat with audio, video, screen and file sharing. GPL-2.0
  • Jami - Peer-to-peer audio and video calls and chat with no central servers or account needed. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Jitsi Meet - Video conferencing you can self-host; the official instance requires you to log in. self-host · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • MiroTalk P2P - Browser-based peer-to-peer video calls up to 4K, with nothing to install. AGPL-3.0
  • Mumble - Low-latency voice chat with encrypted connections, on servers you can run yourself. self-host

Instant Messaging

  • Facebook Messenger: chats have been encrypted since 2023, but Meta still sees who you message, when, and who your contacts are. ToS;DR · Exodus · Source

Instagram / Desktop

  • Instagram: Ireland fined Meta €405 million in 2022 for exposing children's emails and phone numbers on Instagram. ToS;DR · Source
  • Pixelfed - Federated photo sharing with posts, stories and a chronological feed, without ads. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

Location Tracking / Apps and services

  • Google Find Hub (formerly Find My Device): reports your devices' locations to Google. ToS;DR

Teamworking Tools / Desktop

  • Wire - End-to-end encrypted messaging, calls and file sharing for teams, with public and audited code for both the apps and the server. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • Discord: a 2025 breach at a support vendor exposed government ID photos of about 70,000 users. ToS;DR · Source
  • Slack: your messages feed its recommendation models unless a workspace owner emails Slack to opt out. ToS;DR · Source
  • Rocket.Chat - Self-hosted team chat with end-to-end encrypted rooms and federation. ⚠️ website trackers self-host
  • Twake Chat - Workplace chat built on Matrix, part of Linagora's Twake Workplace suite. AGPL-3.0

Maps and Navigation / Apps and services

  • Bing Maps: under Microsoft's very poorly rated privacy policy. ToS;DR
  • Yandex Maps: 11 trackers in its Android app, from a company bound by Russian surveillance law. Exodus
  • Sygic: 8 trackers in its Android app. Exodus
  • OpenStreetMap (OSM) - Collaborative world map built by volunteers, and the open data behind most apps in this section. GPL-2.0
    • OsmAnd - Offline maps and navigation built on OpenStreetMap, with a large set of features. ⚠️ telemetry opt-out Android · iOS · F-Droid
  • Pure Maps - Maps and navigation for Linux phones, Sailfish OS and desktop, fully offline with OSM Scout Server. Linux · GPL-3.0

Search Engines / Useful Tools

  • Yahoo!: a 2013 breach hit all 3 billion Yahoo accounts, which Yahoo admitted only in 2017. ToS;DR · Source
  • Yandex: in 2025 researchers found its Android apps, Yandex Search among them, secretly linked browsing to device IDs. ToS;DR · Source
  • Brave Search - Search engine with its own independent index, from the makers of Brave.
  • DuckDuckGo - Search engine that doesn't build a profile on you, with results drawn largely from Bing.
  • Marginalia - Independent search engine with its own crawler and index that favors text-heavy, non-commercial pages. self-host
  • Mojeek - UK search engine with its own crawler and index and a no-tracking policy.
  • Qwant - French search engine, hosted in the EU, that doesn't track your searches.
  • SearXNG - Metasearch engine that queries other search services for you; use a public instance or host your own. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • YaCy - Peer-to-peer search engine where every user runs a node and shares the index.

Third-party

  • Proton Mail - Email from Switzerland, end-to-end encrypted between Proton users and with PGP, and stored encrypted otherwise, where a court order can still force it to log your IP (2021 case). GPL-3.0

Self-hosted

  • Docker Mailserver - Complete mail server (SMTP, IMAP, antispam, antivirus) in a single Docker container, configured with files. self-host · MIT
  • Mail-in-a-box - Turns a fresh Ubuntu server into a complete mail server with one setup script. self-host · CC0-1.0
  • Mailcow: dockerized - Docker-based mail server suite with a web admin panel, webmail and groupware. self-host · GPL-3.0
  • Mox - Self-contained mail server in a single binary, built to need little maintenance. self-host · MIT

Clients / Android / iOS

  • FairEmail - Full-featured email app that blocks tracking images and keeps everything on your device. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Thunderbird for Android - Mozilla's email app for Android, built on K-9 Mail, which still ships from the same code. Android · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid

Clients / Desktop

  • NeoMutt - Terminal email client with built-in PGP/GPG support, a maintained fork of Mutt. Linux · macOS · CLI · GPL-2.0

Email Alias Services (Anonymous Forwarding) / Desktop

  • addy.io - Email alias and forwarding service you can host yourself, formerly AnonAddy. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • SimpleLogin - Email alias service you can host yourself, owned by Proton. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Alternative clients/modifications of Discord / Desktop

  • Aliucord (⭐4.9k) - Mod for the Android Discord app that disables Discord's tracking (⭐4.9k). Android · OSL-3.0
  • BetterDiscord - Discord client mod; add the DoNotTrack plugin to block trackers. Apache-2.0
  • Legcord - Lightweight Discord client that blocks Discord's known trackers by default, formerly ArmCord. OSL-3.0
  • OpenAsar - Drop-in replacement for part of the Discord desktop app, with a No Tracking (⭐3k) option that turns off crash and error reporting. AGPL-3.0
  • Replugged - Discord client mod that continues the discontinued Powercord. MIT
  • Vencord - Discord client mod with plugins, including one that blocks Discord's tracking. GPL-3.0
  • Vesktop - Desktop Discord client with Vencord built in, which blocks Discord's telemetry. GPL-3.0
  • WebCord (⭐2.5k) - Discord client that loads the web app in Electron instead of using the Discord API, with extra privacy settings. MIT

Blogging platforms (Medium) / Desktop

  • Medium: the site carries trackers, under a poorly rated privacy policy. ToS;DR
  • Plume - Federated blogging engine where readers can follow and comment from any ActivityPub account. 💀 inactive ActivityPub
  • WriteFreely - Minimal, distraction-free blogging platform that can federate posts over ActivityPub. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

YouTube / Desktop

  • YouTube: Google paid a record $170 million in 2019 for collecting children's data on YouTube without parental consent. ToS;DR · Source
  • PeerTube - Federated video hosting where anyone can run an instance and follow channels across others. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

YouTube / Frontends

  • Invidious - YouTube frontend with no ads or Google scripts and subscriptions without an account; see the public instances. AGPL-3.0
  • youtube-local (⭐779) - YouTube client that runs on your computer and opens in the browser, with local subscriptions and optional routing through Tor. Desktop · AGPL-3.0

YouTube / Apps

  • FreeTube - Desktop YouTube app that keeps subscriptions, playlists and history on your computer, without Google's cookies or scripts. Desktop · AGPL-3.0
  • LibreTube - Android YouTube app that fetches videos through Piped instead of Google's servers. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • NewPipe - Lightweight Android YouTube app with background play and downloads, no Google services or account needed. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • SkyTube (⭐2.8k) - Android YouTube app with local subscriptions, downloads and a channel and video blocker. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Yattee (⭐3.8k) - Native YouTube player for iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Mac that works through Invidious or Piped. iOS · macOS · AGPL-3.0

Twitter / Apps

  • Twitter (X): paid $150 million in 2022 for using phone numbers given for account security to target ads. ToS;DR · Source

Twitter / Decentralized

  • Mastodon - Federated microblogging, the largest network in the fediverse. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0 · F-Droid
    • Mastodon Apps - Official directory of Mastodon apps for Android, iOS, web and desktop.
  • Pleroma - Lightweight federated social network server. ActivityPub
    • Soapbox - Web frontend for Pleroma focused on custom branding and ease of use.

Twitter / Frontends

  • Nitter (⭐14k) - Twitter frontend without JavaScript or ads that proxies every request; see the instances list (⭐14k). 💀 inactive AGPL-3.0
  • Squawker (⭐1.5k) - Android Twitter client with no account, tracking or ads, keeping subscriptions on the device; the maintained fork of Fritter. Android · MIT · F-Droid

Reddit / Frontends

  • Reddit: sold Google the right to train AI on users' posts in a 2024 deal valued at about $60 million. ToS;DR · Source

Reddit / Alternatives

  • Lemmy - Federated link aggregator and discussion forum, organized into communities like subreddits. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0
  • Mbin - Federated link aggregator with microblogging, the community-run continuation of kbin. ActivityPub · AGPL-3.0

Streaming Platforms (Twitch) / Apps and frontends

  • Twitch: a 2021 breach leaked 125GB of its data, including source code and three years of creator payouts. ToS;DR · Source
  • Owncast - Self-hosted live streaming server with built-in chat, so you own the stream and your viewers' data. self-host · MIT

Streaming Platforms (Twitch) / Apps

  • Twire (⭐1.3k) - Android Twitch client with built-in ad blocking, VODs with chat replay, and optional login. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid

Imgur / Apps

  • Imgur: a 2014 hack stole about 1.7 million email addresses and passwords, which it only learned of in 2017. ToS;DR · Exodus · Source
  • rimgo - Read-only Imgur frontend that works without JavaScript; see the instances.

IMDb / Apps

  • IMDb: owned by Amazon, with 8 trackers in its Android app. ToS;DR · Exodus
  • libremdb (⭐441) - IMDb frontend without ads or tracking that proxies images and video through the instance. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Fandom / Apps

  • Fandom: wikis loaded with ads and autoplaying video, and 8 trackers in the app. ToS;DR · Exodus

Commenting Engines / Apps

  • Disqus: tracked visitors across sites for ad profiling without consent, Norway's regulator said in 2021. ToS;DR · Source
  • Isso - Lightweight self-hosted comment server, meant as a drop-in replacement for Disqus. self-host · MIT

Translation / Apps

  • DeepL: the free version may train on your texts, and its terms forbid entering any personal data. ToS;DR · Source

Text translation / Apps

  • LibreTranslate - Self-hosted machine translation API and web app with no ties to proprietary services. self-host · AGPL-3.0

Alternative Google Translate frontends / Apps

  • Mozhi - Frontend that proxies Google Translate, DeepL, Yandex and other engines behind one interface. self-host
  • SimplyTranslate - Frontend that proxies your requests to Google Translate and other engines. self-host

RSS Readers / Apps

  • Capy Reader (⭐1.4k) - Small RSS reader, local or synced with Miniflux and FreshRSS. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid (Play Store version has trackers)
  • Feeder (⭐3.1k) - RSS reader that fetches feeds directly on your device, with no account. Android · GPL-3.0
  • Fluent Reader (⭐9.8k) - Desktop RSS reader that keeps your feeds locally, with optional sync to self-hosted services. Linux · Windows · macOS · BSD-3-Clause
  • FreshRSS - Self-hosted feed aggregator with a web interface, multi-user support and an API for mobile apps. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Miniflux - Minimalist self-hosted feed reader with no tracking, written in Go. self-host · Apache-2.0
  • NetNewsWire - RSS reader for Mac, iPhone and iPad that works locally or syncs with self-hosted services. macOS · iOS · MIT
  • Newsboat - RSS reader for the terminal, configured with plain text files. Linux · macOS · CLI · MIT
  • NewsFlash - RSS reader for Linux that works locally or with self-hosted services such as Miniflux and FreshRSS. Linux · GPL-3.0
  • Read You (⭐7.6k) - Material You RSS reader, local or synced with self-hosted services. Android · GPL-3.0

VPNs / Apps

  • SPN - Paid add-on to the Portmaster firewall that routes each app's connections over separate multi-hop paths. Linux · Windows · GPL-3.0

Web Browser / Apps

  • Opera: 6 trackers in its Android app, and owned by a Chinese consortium since 2016. Exodus · Source

Android / iOS / Apps

  • Cromite (⭐8.5k) - Chromium fork, successor to Bromite, with built-in ad blocking and anti-fingerprinting measures. Android · Linux · Windows · GPL-3.0
  • Firefox - Mozilla's browser, with its own engine on Android and Enhanced Tracking Protection on by default. ⚠️ website trackers ⚠️ telemetry opt-out
    • IronFox - Hardened Firefox for Android with proprietary blobs removed, a fork of the discontinued Mull. Android
  • Privacy Browser - Browser that keeps JavaScript, cookies and other tracking features off until you allow them per site. Android
  • Vanadium - Hardened Chromium from the GrapheneOS project, and the default browser on GrapheneOS. Android

Browser Addons / Anti-tracking

  • LibRedirect - Redirects YouTube, Reddit, Google Maps and other sites to privacy-friendly front ends, successor to Privacy Redirect. Browser · GPL-3.0
    • Predirect (⭐279) - Similar extension built on Manifest V3 with minimal permissions, for Chromium browsers that no longer run older extensions. Browser · GPL-3.0

Browser Addons / Useful Tools

  • SingleFile (⭐23k) - Saves a complete web page as a single HTML file you can open offline. Browser · AGPL-3.0

Domains & Hosting / Useful Tools

  • OrangeWebsite - Icelandic web host focused on free speech, with anonymous signup and cryptocurrency or cash payment. ⚠️ website trackers

Link Shorteners / Useful Tools

  • Bitly: built to track every click for marketing analytics. ToS;DR
  • Kutt - Shortener with custom domains and password-protected links that you can host yourself. self-host · MIT
  • YOURLS - Self-hosted shortener written in PHP, with its own click stats and a plugin system. self-host · MIT

Captchas / Useful Tools

  • hCaptcha: its privacy policy says it supplies the answers visitors give to its puzzles as AI training data. ToS;DR · Source
  • ALTCHA - Self-hosted proof-of-work captcha with no cookies or tracking. self-host · MIT
  • mCaptcha - Proof-of-work captcha that rate-limits bots by making each request cost some computation. self-host · AGPL-3.0
  • Private Captcha - EU-made proof-of-work captcha, as a hosted service or on your own server. ⚠️ source-available self-host

2FA / Useful Tools

  • Authy: needs your phone number, and a 2024 leak exposed 33 million of them. Source
  • Microsoft Authenticator: 5 trackers in its Android app, and no way to export your tokens to another app. Exodus
  • 2FAS Auth - Authenticator whose browser extension asks your phone for a code and fills it in, no account needed. GPL-3.0
  • Aegis - Encrypted token vault that imports from most other authenticators and exports in plain or encrypted form. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • ente Auth - Authenticator with end-to-end encrypted sync between your devices, from the makers of ente Photos. ⚠️ website trackers AGPL-3.0
  • FreeOTPPlus (⭐750) - Fork of FreeOTP with backups, search and dark mode. Android · Apache-2.0 · F-Droid
  • Stratum (⭐4.6k) - Authenticator with Wear OS support and encrypted backups. Android · GPL-3.0

Password Managers / Useful Tools

  • KeePassXC - Offline password manager that keeps your vault in an encrypted file you control, with no account or sync service. Linux · macOS · Windows
    • KeePassDX - KeePass-compatible password manager for Android. Android · GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
    • Strongbox - KeePass-compatible password manager for iPhone, iPad and Mac. iOS · macOS · AGPL-3.0

Encryption / Useful Tools

  • age - Simple, modern file encryption with small keys and nothing to configure. CLI · BSD-3-Clause
  • Cryptomator - Encrypts files on your device before they reach any cloud storage provider. GPL-3.0 · F-Droid
  • Shufflecake - Hidden encrypted volumes for Linux with plausible deniability, so nobody can prove the hidden data exists. Linux

Privacy vs Security vs Anonymity / Apps and services

  • Privacy is control over your personal information: knowing what is collected about you, and deciding who can access it and how.
  • Security is protection of your information from unauthorized access or theft, so attackers can't get at it.
  • Anonymity means your actions can't be traced back to you. Someone may see what is done, but not who did it.

6. Tools

Response

Favicon

Tools collection

AI Coding

Browser Automation

9. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 💸 Gridwright Studio - Subscription library of pixel-art game asset packs (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Free samples with a free account. Drawn in code with AI-assisted tools.

Graphics / Animation

Graphics / Modeling

  • 💸 Unity Asset Exporter - Open .unitypackage files in the browser without Unity and export models as textured GLB.

10. Awesome Connectivity Info

Global Indexes

  • cable.co.uk Worldwide Broadband Price Comparison - Index of broadband costs around the world based on fixed line and wireless access. (2023) (2022) (2019) (2018)

Global Indexes / Discontinued

  • A4AI Affordability Drivers Index - Index of internet affordability by the Alliance for Affordable Internet Access (last published 2021). (2021) (2020)
  • A4AI Mobile Broadband Data Costs - Price of broadband data (1GB mobile prepaid) as % of GNI per capita (last published 2020). (2020) (Q4 2018) (2017)

Connectivity Maps / Discontinued

  • Global CDN Infrastructure Map - Open data map of Content Distribution Networks around the world hosted by NSRC (May 2024).

  • Hurricane Electric 3D Map - Interactive 3D map of undersea cables and Hurricane Electric Points of Presence (POPs) and routes.
  • nperf Mobile Coverage Maps - Mobile coverage based on data collected from the nperf app.

Periodic Global Reports / Discontinued

  • We Are Social / Meltwater Digital - Annual report on internet and social media adoption. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • GSMA Mobile Gender Gap Report - Gender gaps in mobile ownership and mobile internet use in low- and middle-income countries. (2026) (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) · archive
  • Broadband Commission: The State of Broadband - Annual flagship report on broadband access, affordability, and use. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022) (2021) · archive

  • ITU Measuring Digital Development - Facts and Figures annual estimates of global connectivity. (2026) (2025) (LLDCs 2025) (2024) (2024 Small Island States) · archive
  • ITU Measuring Digital Development: ICT Price Trends - Analysis and comparison of price data for mobile-voice services, mobile data and fixed broadband. Replaces the Measuring the Information Society Report. (2024) (2019)
  • UN E-Government Survey - Global E-Government and E-Participation Development Index; underlying country data in the UN E-Government Knowledge Database. (2024) (2022) (2020) (2018) (2016)
  • Mozilla Internet Health Report - Annual look at the health of the internet (last published 2020). (2020) (2019) (2018)
  • ITU Measuring the Information Society - Earlier ITU series on ICT development, later replaced by Measuring Digital Development (discontinued). (2018) (2017)
  • Deloitte - Global Mobile Consumer Trends - Survey of mobile consumer behaviour across markets (discontinued).

Regional Reports and Data / Discontinued

  • GSMA Mobile Economy - Middle East & North Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for MENA. (2025) (2024) (2023) (2022)
  • GSMA Mobile Economy - West Africa - Regional Mobile Economy report for West Africa. (2019) (2018)

  • RIA Africa Mobile Pricing (RAMP) Indices Portal - Pricing information on Voice/SMS basket, 1GB data basket, and Value For Money bundles (Q3 2022).
