  • Opensignal - The State of Mobile Network Experience in Africa - Download speeds and network quality in 27 African countries (November 2024).
  • Lions go digital: The Internet's transformative potential in Africa - Report by McKinsey on the potential impact of the Internet in Africa (last published 2013).

Data and Measurement / Discontinued

  • Opensignal - State of Mobile Networks Reports - Country reports based on Opensignal data gathering.

11. Awesome Cpp

Online Compiler

  • Devtoolry - An online C/C++ compiler that runs Clang in the browser via WebAssembly.

12. ALL About RSS

Apps / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • Newsbin : a native RSS reader for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch with optional on-device AI, free to try
  • Feedler : a smart RSS reader with an in-house full-article parser and cross-source Trending Stories, free for five feeds then €9.99/year

Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • Sublime Feed : an RSS reader without unread counts, free for five feeds then $4/month or $40/year

Self Hosted Readers / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • FeedThing (⭐5) : a Django reader with a two-pane catch-up model and river-of-news folders, self-hosted on gunicorn
  • Tuvix : an open-source RSS aggregator, self-host it or use the free hosted app
  • Simple Feed Reader (⭐8) : a self-hosted multi-user reader with full-text extraction, email digests and Bluesky/Mastodon timelines and lists as feeds, Docker Compose deploy

🧾Other Lists that Collect RSS Things / Outline Processor Markup Language

  • The RSS Universe : a living directory of 133 RSS apps, tools and standards, links checked live

specifically from (a certain platform) / Steam

  • Owned Steam Game RSS Feeds : generates an .opml of news feeds for the games you own, optionally including wishlisted, free and unplayed titles

specifically from (a certain platform) / TMDB

  • Magnanium : generates an RSS feed for the upcoming releases of any actor or director, filterable by role, release type and lead time

Toolbox / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • FeedCraft (⭐313): an RSS middleware in Go that translates, extracts full text, renders JS-heavy pages, and summarizes or filters items with an LLM

Feed item filtering / Webpage Monitor Services with capability of monitoring RSS Feed 1264

  • Feed Rinse: filter items out by keyword, author or category; the link goes to the pre-2.0 site, which is still the only working one

13. Awesome Osint

Web Monitoring / GitHub

  • Topic Watch (⭐15) - Self-hosted news monitor that uses an LLM to only notify on genuinely new information.

14. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • TimeLogic API - World time and timezone API with cryptographically signed JSON responses, so you can verify the time wasn't tampered with. Get the current time by timezone, IP address or coordinates, convert between zones, check DST changes, and do business-day date math. WorldTimeAPI-compatible endpoints for apps that used worldtimeapi.org. Free plan includes 10,000 requests/month on all endpoints.

Security and PKI

  • CyberShield Studio - Security monitoring for e-commerce store operators and developers. Weekly scans for JavaScript changes or injection, tracking before consent, security header settings, and vulnerable client-side libraries and WordPress plugins. Free plan monitors 1 store (home page + checkout path) with 30 days of history. No credit card required.

Monitoring

  • Gairė - Web Change monitoring for research, price changes, out-of/in stock monitoring. Free plan up to 10 pages checked every hour, alerts by sms, email, Webhook, Slack/Discord/Telegram integrations. No card needed.
  • hypermonitors.com - Monitors your infrastructure from three different locations (ZH - NYC - SG) with every outage checked from a 2nd location before alerts go out. Free forever for 5 monitors and 5 minute checks.

Forms

  • whatayarn - Online form builder. Unlimited forms and responses on Free, subject to fair use.

Generative AI

  • evalship - find the flaws in your LLM evals. Reviews your evals suite for improvement opportunities, monitors your PRs for any eval regressions or unintended side effects and optimizes your prompts and models based on experiments in your product. Free for 1 private repo for 1 user, 100 PR analyses a month, 30 days of eval history. Free for public repos.

PaaS

  • EthioDeploy - Hosting and agentic coding platform containing Built-in Analytics, Database, GitHub CI/CD, free sub-domain, CLI, AI coding agent. Free tier allows one project 256 MB RAM / 0.5 CPU, sleeps after 30 min idle, 512 MB database and 100,000 tokens on the default model one time.

Issue Tracking and Project Management

  • Archboard - Architecture diagrams your team and AI agents edit live. Free plan: 1 seat, 3 diagrams, all built-in node packs and live editing with your AI agents (MCP).
  • UserJot - Live chat, feedback boards, a roadmap, and a changelog, so everything your customers say reaches the people and agents building your product. Free plan: Unlimited Posts, Unlimited Users, 3 Admin Roles, 2 Feedback Boards, Roadmap, Changelog.

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Pug - Open-source product analytics with autocapture, trends, funnels, retention, user flows and unified user profiles. Free plan includes 100,000 events per month and 1 year of data retention.

Payment and Billing Integration

  • UsageRail - API keys, rate limits, quotas and usage-based billing for paid APIs, checked inside your own server with no gateway. Free up to $1,000/month billed and 1M requests/month.

15. Awesome Gemini Cli

Development Tools & Utilities

  • Skim (⭐16) - Browser extension that renders the Markdown plans and docs Gemini CLI writes, re-rendering live as the file changes. KaTeX, Mermaid, folder view.

MCP Servers

  • AlphaOSINT LinkedIn Company - Remote MCP server for Gemini CLI that returns a company's LinkedIn page details (size, industry, locations, specialties) through https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=johnvc/linkedin-company-api.

16. Awesome Neovim

Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

  • alessandropietrobelli/dotnet-tree.nvim (⭐3) - A .NET solution explorer as a neo-tree source, showing solution folders, projects, project references and package versions, with support for many dotnet actions.

Programming Languages Support / Markdown and LaTeX

  • ywsrock/nvim-md-preview (⭐2) - Markdown preview in your browser with two-way cursor sync, Mermaid and KaTeX support, and PDF/DOCX/HTML/EPUB export.

Utility / Cursorline

  • alexcloudstar/cheatsheet.nvim (⭐1) - Telescope cheatsheet for your keybindings; look up a key by task or keyword and add your own keys.

Formatting / Folding

  • javanoo6/intellij-formatter.nvim (⭐1) - IntelliJ-powered formatting through conform.nvim, with EditorConfig support, Java import cleanup, and a reusable daemon.

17. Awesome Mac

Terminal Apps / Databases

  • SSHTermaq - PuTTY-compatible SSH, Telnet and serial terminal with tabs, split panes, an SFTP/SCP file manager and one-click PuTTY session import.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Tingo (⭐6) - Open-source meeting notes app that records any call, transcribes it and tells speakers apart on device, and writes minutes whose every point links back to the original audio, using the LLM you choose.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Ferrocast - Fast keyboard launcher written in Rust, with clipboard history, snippets, window management and 275 local file conversions.

Utilities / Window Management

  • LumaRing (⭐82) - Radial menu for switching apps, windows, and browser tabs.

18. Awesome Rust

Applications / Text editors

  • sventmueller/splat (⭐4) - An ultrafast native Markdown editor for macOS on AppKit, no Electron. Edits in the preview leave untouched lines byte-for-byte identical, so Git diffs stay clean. LaTeX and Mermaid offline, 35 languages.

19. Awesome Testing

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • llmdrill (⭐0) - Open-source CLI that runs your app behind a local fake of the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, injects outages (529/503 overloads, 429 with retry-after, hangs, cut streams) and grades its retries, backoff, timeouts and failover.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • GenClass (⭐7) - Open-source browser library that reports race conditions in a web app while they happen (stale responses written over newer data, duplicate submits, failure storms) with a small on-device model. Its local MCP server re-runs a page with responses delivered in different orders to find races and replays one order to prove a fix.
  • Replay QA - Autonomous QA agent for web apps built on Replay's time-travel runtime recording and analysis. It explores an app from its URL, writes and runs Playwright tests, and delivers a root-cause analysis for each failure, backed by evidence from the recorded execution. Free tier, no credit card.

#### [3. Awesome Healthcare](/content/kakoni/awesome-healthcare/README.md)

##### Contents / EHR

*   [Akello (⭐42)](https://github.com/akello-io/akello) - Integrated Mental Health Infrastructure
*   [Beda EMR (⭐132)](https://github.com/beda-software/fhir-emr) - EMR built natively on FHIR.
*   [BHIMA (⭐234)](https://github.com/third-culture-software/bhima) - Hospital information and accounting system for rural hospitals.
*   [CARE (⭐419)](https://github.com/ohcnetwork/care) - Digital public good for hospital administration and decentralized patient care.
*   [FerroEHR (⭐85)](https://github.com/FerroHEALTH/FerroEHR) - openEHR Clinical Data Repository written in Rust, with ITS-REST and AQL support on PostgreSQL.
*   [GitEHR (⭐6)](https://github.com/gitehr/gitehr) - Patient-owned, self-hostable EHR stored as plain-text files in a Git repository. Append-only journal, immutable documents, offline-first, no database.
*   [HasteHealth (⭐85)](https://github.com/HasteHealth/HasteHealth) - Scalable FHIR server and clinical data repository.
*   [ICTHospital (⭐115)](https://github.com/ictinnovations/ICTHospital) - Hospital management software with built-in unified communications, built on Laravel.
*   [Marley (⭐555)](https://github.com/earthians/marley) - Health information system built on the Frappe framework.
*   [Open Hospital (⭐638)](https://github.com/informatici/openhospital) - Electronic Medical Record software for underprivileged rural hospitals.

##### Contents / Scribe

*   [Phlox (⭐110)](https://github.com/bloodworks-io/phlox) - Open source (MIT), self-hosted AI medical scribe with realtime note drafting, RAG, and MCP-extensible agents; runs as a desktop app or Docker image.

##### Contents / Imaging

*   [Cornerstone3D (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/cornerstonejs/cornerstone3D) - JavaScript libraries for building web-based medical imaging platforms.
*   [dcm2niix (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/rordenlab/dcm2niix) - DICOM to NIfTI converter.
*   [highdicom (⭐241)](https://github.com/ImagingDataCommons/highdicom) - High-level DICOM abstractions for Python, including segmentations, structured reports and annotations.
*   [Horos (⭐643)](https://github.com/horosproject/horos) - Medical image viewer.
*   [MedPy (⭐623)](https://github.com/loli/medpy) - Python library for medical image processing, supporting DICOM and NIfTI formats with tools for segmentation, filtering, and feature extraction.
*   [mercure (⭐104)](https://github.com/mercure-imaging/mercure) - DICOM orchestrator for routing and processing imaging studies.
*   [MONAI Label (⭐908)](https://github.com/Project-MONAI/MONAILabel) - AI-assisted image labeling tool that works with 3D Slicer and OHIF.
*   [PyMedPhys (⭐368)](https://github.com/pymedphys/pymedphys) - Community library for medical physics.
*   [QuPath (⭐1.5k)](https://github.com/qupath/qupath) - Bioimage analysis and whole slide image analysis for digital pathology.
*   [SlicerDMRI (⭐86)](https://github.com/SlicerDMRI/SlicerDMRI) - Extension for 3D Slicer focused on diffusion MRI analysis and visualization, supporting neuroscience research.
*   [Weasis (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/nroduit/Weasis) - Standalone and web-based DICOM viewer.

##### Contents / Dental

*   [DentalPin (⭐110)](https://github.com/martinezsalmeron/dentalpin) - Dental practice management with an AI agent that runs real operations.

##### Contents / Laboratory

*   [MISO (⭐316)](https://github.com/miso-lims/miso-lims) - Laboratory information management system for NGS sequencing centres.

##### Contents / Frameworks

*   [CHT](https://communityhealthtoolkit.org/) - Community Health Toolkit - set of Open Source tools that support community healthcare
*   [HAPI FHIR JPA Server Starter (⭐544)](https://github.com/hapifhir/hapi-fhir-jpaserver-starter) - Ready-to-deploy FHIR server built on HAPI FHIR.
*   [Helios FHIR Server (⭐57)](https://github.com/HeliosSoftware/hfs) - FHIR server written in Rust, optimized for clinical analytics workloads.
*   [Opal (⭐288)](https://github.com/openhealthcare/opal) - Framework for building clinical applications.
*   [Spezi (⭐261)](https://github.com/StanfordSpezi/Spezi) - Stanford framework for building interoperable digital health apps on Apple platforms.

##### Contents / Libraries

*   [dcmjs (⭐356)](https://github.com/dcmjs-org/dcmjs) - JavaScript implementation of DICOM manipulation.
*   [deid (⭐182)](https://github.com/pydicom/deid) - De-identification of DICOM images in Python.
*   [dicom-rs (⭐570)](https://github.com/Enet4/dicom-rs) - Rust implementation of the DICOM standard.
*   [fhir.resources (⭐543)](https://github.com/nazrulworld/fhir.resources) - Pydantic-based FHIR resource models for Python.
*   [fhir-py (⭐218)](https://github.com/beda-software/fhir-py) - Async and sync FHIR client for Python.
*   [HealthChain (⭐230)](https://github.com/healthchainai/HealthChain) - Python SDK for building healthcare AI applications with FHIR tools and real-time EHR connectivity.
*   [MITK](https://www.mitk.org/) - The Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit.
*   [nHapi (⭐313)](https://github.com/nHapiNET/nHapi) - .NET port of the HAPI HL7 v2 library.
*   [nhs-number (⭐6)](https://github.com/wardle/nhs-number) - A Clojure/Script library providing validation, formatting and generation of UK NHS Numbers
*   [nhs-number (⭐14)](https://github.com/uk-fci/nhs-number) - Python package to provide utilities for NHS Numbers, including validity checks, normalisation, and generation.
*   [Pydicom (⭐2.2k)](https://github.com/pydicom/pydicom) - Pure Python package for working with DICOM files, enabling reading, writing, and manipulation of medical imaging data.
*   [sct (⭐32)](https://github.com/pacharanero/sct) - File-based SNOMED-CT toolset built in Rust.
*   [SMART on FHIR JavaScript client (⭐355)](https://github.com/smart-on-fhir/client-js) - JavaScript client for SMART on FHIR apps.

##### Contents / Applications

*   [AirwayLab (⭐45)](https://github.com/airwaylab-app/airwaylab) - Browser-based airway analysis dashboard for PAP therapy users with flow limitation scoring, breathing pattern analysis, and oximetry metrics.
*   [CommCare HQ (⭐525)](https://github.com/dimagi/commcare-hq) - Server for CommCare, a mobile data collection platform for frontline health workers.
*   [OpenSRP FHIR Core (⭐70)](https://github.com/opensrp/fhircore) - Offline-capable Android app for community health workers, built on the Android FHIR SDK.
*   [RCPCH Digital Growth Charts](https://growth.rcpch.ac.uk) - Open source Digital Growth Charts platform with API, CLI, Python package, React chart components.
*   [SORMAS (⭐334)](https://github.com/SORMAS-Foundation/SORMAS-Project) - Surveillance, outbreak response management and analysis system.

##### Contents / PHR

*   [AndroidAPS (⭐1.2k)](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS) - Open source automated insulin delivery system for Android.
*   [Loop (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/LoopKit/Loop) - Automated insulin delivery app for iOS.
*   [Nightscout (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/nightscout/cgm-remote-monitor) - Web monitor for continuous glucose monitor data.
*   [OpenHealth (⭐4k)](https://github.com/OpenHealthForAll/open-health) - Privacy-first AI health assistant that interprets personal health data (blood tests, checkups, family history, symptoms) with local LLM support via Ollama.
*   [Trio (⭐419)](https://github.com/nightscout/Trio) - Automated insulin delivery system for iOS based on the OpenAPS algorithm.
*   [xDrip+ (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip) - Android app for collecting and displaying continuous glucose monitor data.

##### Contents / Research

*   [admiral (⭐324)](https://github.com/pharmaverse/admiral) - R package from pharmaverse for creating ADaM clinical trial datasets.
*   [LibreClinica (⭐83)](https://github.com/reliatec-gmbh/LibreClinica) - Electronic data capture for clinical trials, community successor of OpenClinica.
*   [OHDSI ATLAS (⭐335)](https://github.com/OHDSI/Atlas) - Web tool for observational research on OMOP CDM data.

##### Contents / Integration

*   [LinuxForHealth HL7v2-FHIR Converter (⭐110)](https://github.com/LinuxForHealth/hl7v2-fhir-converter) - Converts HL7 v2 messages to FHIR resources.
*   [mirthSync (⭐104)](https://github.com/SagaHealthcareIT/mirthsync) - CLI for putting Mirth Connect and Open Integration Engine configuration under version control.
*   [Open Integration Engine (⭐240)](https://github.com/OpenIntegrationEngine/engine) - Community open source fork of Mirth Connect.

##### Contents / Bioinformatics

*   [cBioPortal (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/cBioPortal/cbioportal) - Platform for exploring and visualizing cancer genomics data.
*   [GATK (⭐2k)](https://github.com/broadinstitute/gatk) - Broad Institute toolkit for variant discovery in high-throughput sequencing data.
*   [Hail (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/hail-is/hail) - Scalable genomic data analysis.
*   [nf-core/sarek (⭐616)](https://github.com/nf-core/sarek) - Pipeline to detect germline and somatic variants from sequencing data.
*   [scikit-bio (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio) - Python library for bioinformatics, providing tools for sequence analysis, microbiome studies, and statistical analysis of biological data.

##### Contents / Data

*   [DHIS2 (⭐360)](https://github.com/dhis2/dhis2-core) - Health information management platform used by national health systems.
*   [medspaCy (⭐684)](https://github.com/medspacy/medspacy) - Library for clinical NLP with spaCy.
*   [OpenMRS FHIR Analytics (⭐228)](https://github.com/google/fhir-data-pipes) - Pipeline tools for transforming OpenMRS data to FHIR-based analytics using Apache Beam.
*   [Pathling (⭐140)](https://github.com/aehrc/pathling) - FHIR and clinical terminology analytics on Apache Spark.
*   [Snowstorm (⭐399)](https://github.com/IHTSDO/snowstorm) - SNOMED International's SNOMED CT terminology server.
*   [Tuva (⭐333)](https://github.com/tuva-health/tuva-core) - Open source data model, data marts and data quality tests for claims and clinical data.

##### Contents / Machine learning

*   [nnU-Net (⭐9k)](https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnUNet) - Self-configuring deep learning framework for biomedical image segmentation.
*   [Odyssey (⭐63)](https://github.com/VectorInstitute/odyssey) - Interpretable foundation model of the patient clinical timeline for event forecasting and time-to-event prediction.
*   [OpenMed (⭐5.8k)](https://github.com/maziyarpanahi/openmed) - Local clinical named-entity recognition and PHI de-identification models.
*   [PathML (⭐467)](https://github.com/Dana-Farber-AIOS/PathML) - Python library for digital pathology image analysis, providing tools for preprocessing, model training, and analysis of histological slides.
*   [seismometer (⭐272)](https://github.com/epic-open-source/seismometer) - Epic's framework for evaluating AI models in healthcare.
*   [TorchIO (⭐2.5k)](https://github.com/TorchIO-project/torchio) - Medical image preprocessing and augmentation for deep learning.

Contents / Research

  • admiral (⭐324) - R package from pharmaverse for creating ADaM clinical trial datasets.
  • LibreClinica (⭐83) - Electronic data capture for clinical trials, community successor of OpenClinica.
  • OHDSI ATLAS (⭐335) - Web tool for observational research on OMOP CDM data.

Contents / Integration

  • LinuxForHealth HL7v2-FHIR Converter (⭐110) - Converts HL7 v2 messages to FHIR resources.
  • mirthSync (⭐104) - CLI for putting Mirth Connect and Open Integration Engine configuration under version control.
  • Open Integration Engine (⭐240) - Community open source fork of Mirth Connect.

Contents / Bioinformatics

  • cBioPortal (⭐1.1k) - Platform for exploring and visualizing cancer genomics data.
  • GATK (⭐2k) - Broad Institute toolkit for variant discovery in high-throughput sequencing data.
  • Hail (⭐1.1k) - Scalable genomic data analysis.
  • nf-core/sarek (⭐616) - Pipeline to detect germline and somatic variants from sequencing data.
  • scikit-bio (⭐1.3k) - Python library for bioinformatics, providing tools for sequence analysis, microbiome studies, and statistical analysis of biological data.

Contents / Data

  • DHIS2 (⭐360) - Health information management platform used by national health systems.
  • medspaCy (⭐684) - Library for clinical NLP with spaCy.
  • OpenMRS FHIR Analytics (⭐228) - Pipeline tools for transforming OpenMRS data to FHIR-based analytics using Apache Beam.
  • Pathling (⭐140) - FHIR and clinical terminology analytics on Apache Spark.
  • Snowstorm (⭐399) - SNOMED International's SNOMED CT terminology server.
  • Tuva (⭐333) - Open source data model, data marts and data quality tests for claims and clinical data.

Contents / Machine learning

  • nnU-Net (⭐9k) - Self-configuring deep learning framework for biomedical image segmentation.
  • Odyssey (⭐63) - Interpretable foundation model of the patient clinical timeline for event forecasting and time-to-event prediction.
  • OpenMed (⭐5.8k) - Local clinical named-entity recognition and PHI de-identification models.
  • PathML (⭐467) - Python library for digital pathology image analysis, providing tools for preprocessing, model training, and analysis of histological slides.
  • seismometer (⭐272) - Epic's framework for evaluating AI models in healthcare.
  • TorchIO (⭐2.5k) - Medical image preprocessing and augmentation for deep learning.
  • TotalSegmentator (⭐3.1k) - Segmentation of more than 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR images.

Contents / Compliance

  • HealthStack (⭐94) - Terraform modules for secure and compliant healthcare infrastructure on AWS.

4. Awesome Vue

Resources / External Resources

  • FrontendAtlas Vue Interview Questions - Vue interview questions with explained answers and runnable examples; free to read, some coding exercises are paid.

Projects Using Vue.js / Open Source

  • Oxynote (⭐480) - Self-hosted collaborative documentation built with Nuxt 4, Tiptap and Yjs: live Prometheus charts as editor blocks, draft reviews with visual diffs, and an Electron desktop build.
  • EdgeChat (⭐1.4k) - Open-source team chat built with Vue 3, Vite, and Cloudflare Workers, with group and direct messages, Telegram bridging, file sharing, and WebRTC voice calls.

Projects Using Vue.js / Commercial Products

  • Beekeeper Studio - Cross-platform SQL editor and database client built with Vue.js and Electron, with a free open-source Community Edition.

Projects Using Vue.js / Apps/Websites

  • A11yKit - 15 free, client-side web accessibility and WCAG 2.2 testing tools with zero code uploads.
  • Remove Audio Tools - Over 30 free browser tools for video and audio (convert, compress, extract MP3, make GIFs, separate voice and music with AI) that process files on the device with FFmpeg.wasm and WebGPU. Built with Nuxt and Vue.

Components & Libraries / Frameworks

  • OpenVue (⭐421) - MIT-licensed Vue 3 UI component library with a complete set of themable components, forked from PrimeVue 4.5.5.

Components & Libraries / UI Components

  • TradeCanvas (⭐28) - Vue 3 component for trading charts: candlesticks to Renko, 111 indicators, drawing tools and live exchange feeds.
  • File Viewer (⭐2.6k) - Vue 3 file-preview component with lazy renderer presets covering 275 registered extensions, including experimental formats, across Office, PDF, CAD, 3D models, and archives.
  • kritzel (⭐5) - Infinite canvas component library for Vue.

Components & Libraries / UI Utilities

  • Formhaus (⭐8) - Forms from one JSON definition for Vue and React.

Components & Libraries / Utilities

  • Lingui - Internationalization for Vue 3. Write messages in plain language right in your templates, and Lingui takes care of the rest.
  • vue-qs (⭐25) - Type-safe URL query state for Vue 3 and Nuxt, a port of nuqs. Writable refs synced with the search params, with typed parsers, batching and throttling.

Components & Libraries / Dev Tools

  • vue-why-render (⭐12) - shows why Vue 3 components re-render: highlights renders on the page and names the cause (props, state, Pinia stores, route changes, computeds), with a panel and a Nuxt module.

5. Tools

UI Builders

  • Particle Logo - Turn a logo into a particle animation in the browser, then export dependency-free HTML, Vue 3 and React components, or video and GIF.

6. Awesome Privacy

Desktop / Useful Tools

  • BusKill - USB dead man's switch that locks or wipes your computer when the cable is pulled away. GPL-3.0
  • dnscrypt-proxy (⭐14k) - Local DNS proxy with encrypted DNS and anonymized relays, so resolvers can't link your lookups to your IP. ISC
  • MAT2 (⭐387) - Removes metadata from images, documents, audio and many other file types. Linux · CLI · LGPL-3.0
  • Metadata Cleaner - Simple desktop app to view and remove file metadata, built on MAT2. Linux
  • Mobile Verification Toolkit (⭐16k) - Amnesty International's tool for checking Android and iOS devices for traces of spyware such as Pegasus. ⚠️ source-available CLI
  • OpenSnitch (⭐14k) - Application firewall that asks before any program connects to the internet. Linux · GPL-3.0

7. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 Minecraft Pixel Art - Browser image-to-Minecraft block blueprints with material lists, PNG plans and Java structure NBT export; no account required.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 SpriteCanvas Sprite Sheet Tools - Free browser tools that slice a sprite sheet into frames, pack images into a sheet, convert GIFs to sheets and back, and turn MP4/WebM clips into sheets with a JSON atlas. Files stay on your device; no account needed.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Flockbay - Free AI game maker built on Godot: a desktop app where an AI agent builds and playtests a Godot 4 project on your disk, on free hosted AI, your own Claude or ChatGPT account, or your own agent over MCP. Optional paid plans add hosted AI usage.
  • 💸 SpriteCanvas - AI sprite animation generator for 2D games: make a character from text or an image, animate idle, walk, run, jump and attack moves, and export transparent PNG sprite sheets with a JSON atlas for Phaser, PixiJS and Godot. Free daily credits.

8. Collective Ai Tools

Developer Tools

  • Browser Agent Blueprint (⭐1) - Open-source browser agent prompt modules and synthetic recovery examples for uncertain actions. #free #opensource
  • Keenable - Independent web search index for AI agents: search and page fetch over API, CLI and MCP (https://api.keenable.ai/mcp), with 100K free requests a month and keyless public endpoints. #freemium #api #mcp
  • Model Salt - Open source MCP server with one tool: before a creative task the model gets a few choices drawn from atmospheric and quantum noise, so one prompt gives different answers that still do what was asked. #free #opensource #mcp
  • SoloPup Memory (⭐1) - Native DeepSeek Harness text-memory beta with source references, project scope and correction history; requires Node >=24.9 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0 <0.3.0, and configured model APIs may charge. #opensource #memory

Image Editing

  • Clarpex AI - Free online AI photo fixer to unblur, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, remove glare and upscale to 4K or 8K, with daily free credits and no sign-up. #freemium #photo

Image Generator

  • MakeImg - AI photo generator that turns a text prompt or reference photo into a new image, with 11 models and free daily credits. #freemium #image
  • QuestStudio - Generate and edit images, then continue related video, voice, and music workflows in a connected creative studio. #paid #design

Video

  • RefVid - Generates AI videos from 1–10 reference photos of a character or product, using the photos to help maintain character or product consistency. New accounts get one free 5-second clip, then paid credits or plans. #paid

Writing

  • CoverNice - KDP cover studio: five directions, spine width from page count, 300 dpi wrap PDF. #freemium

9. Awesome Lowcode

AI

  • kdpbook.io - No-code AI book studio: describe a book in a chat and get it written, illustrated and typeset, with the Amazon KDP print PDF, full-wrap cover, Kindle eBook and listing sheet.
  • Pinegen AI - Generate, fix, and backtest compiler-validated Pine Script v6 strategies for TradingView using AI. Free to start, no coding needed.

Automation

  • Upload-Post - Social media publishing API for posting and scheduling to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and more. Integrates with Zapier, Make, and n8n, and has an MCP server. Free plan available.

Educational

  • Benian n8n Automation Catalog - n8n workflow examples with setup guides and runnable walkthroughs using fictional data.

Flow-based programming

  • Ciaren - Open-source, local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder that exports readable pandas or Polars code.

Marketing

  • thirds.ai - Make branded images and PDFs from editable templates in a studio, AI assistant, or API.
  • Stripo - No-code email design platform with 1,690+ templates and export to 90+ ESPs.

Online database creator apps

  • Nhost - Open source Postgres backend with a dashboard for tables and permissions, an instant GraphQL API, auth, storage and functions.
  • PHPRunner - Commercial low-code builder for web applications using existing databases, with forms, reports, permissions, and deployment to your own web server.

Visual programming

  • Figment.so - Publish Figma designs as websites through a Figma plugin.
  • Helmpages - Websites for independent professionals and small businesses, built and kept current by sending a message. Paid, with a free trial.
  • HtmlDrag - Visual editor for existing and AI-generated HTML pages, with drag-and-drop editing, element-level AI refinement, and HTML export.
  • BuzzBlender Kiosk Editor - No-code kiosk interface builder for creating button-based experiences with video, images and text, with preview and standalone HTML export.

Misc

  • BESSER (⭐200) - Open-source Python low-code platform: draw a UML model in a web editor and generate FastAPI, React, Django and SQLAlchemy code.
  • BESSER Agentic Framework (⭐71) - Design and implement agents and chatbots in Python.

10. Discount for Student Dev

Infrastructure Monitoring

  • Kilobat [FREE] - macOS network monitoring app; eligible students aged 13+ get one year of Pro for two Macs with a school email, renewable while studying.

Software Packs

  • Student AI Deals [FREE] - A verified list of AI tools and credits students can get free with a student email or GitHub Education, such as Copilot Pro, Azure for Students and JetBrains, with the exact requirements for each.

11. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • claude-guard (⭐0) - checks your egress IP before Claude Code starts. If the IP that claude.ai sees is not on your allowlist, claude stops and asks before it connects.
  • sprout (⭐1) - Turn a Jira ticket into a clean git branch. One command. A short, descriptive name. Zero copy-pasting.
  • walh-shell (⭐2) - A fast, modern, and extensible Zsh (and Bash) plugin for instant terminal color theme switching that lets you instantly change your terminal’s color scheme with a single command.

12. Awesome Go

Databases / SQL Query Builders

  • doug-martin/goqu (⭐2.7k) — SQL builder and query library for golang ☆2,675

13. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • EndoStack (⭐4) - Security-first workflows for coding agents: 62 skills that threat-model changes, security-review diffs and verify results by running them. Works in Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 11 other agents. MIT.
  • Preloop (⭐85) - Open-source AI agent control plane and software factory: every tool and model call allowed, denied or held for a human, budgeted and recorded, and agents run from tickets, webhooks and CI in hosted containers or on your own runners, landing work as pull requests. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot CLI. Apache-2.0.
  • AgentVera - Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 13 more coding agents per project, each in a real terminal using your own Gemini CLI install and login. A team kanban board hands cards to agents, and an MCP manager is built in. Closed source; free plan, Pro $9.99/month.

MCP Servers

  • Keenable (⭐2) - Web search and page fetch as clean Markdown from Keenable, a search engine with its own crawler and index built for AI agents. Gemini CLI extension that adds Keenable's hosted MCP server (search_web_pages, fetch_page_content) and a web-lookup skill; keyless, no signup or API key (rate limited per IP). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity.
  • repofit (⭐4) - MCP server and CLI that reads what local coding agents already keep (Gemini CLI chats and GEMINI.md, plus Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and others) and recommends GitHub projects for the tasks you repeat, each pick citing the session it came from. Also lists installed MCP servers and skills that no session ever called. Runs locally and uses the agent's own model, so no API key. MIT. Add with gemini mcp add repofit uvx repofit mcp.

14. Awesome Neovim

Game / Tmux

  • navasvarela/vimdojo (⭐0) - Puzzle game for learning Vim motions and workflows, scored on keystrokes against par.

15. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • Breaker (⭐0) - Watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one breaks.
  • mirroir-mcp - Open-source MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents see, tap, swipe and type on a real iPhone through iPhone Mirroring, without Developer Mode or Xcode.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Murmury (⭐1) - Floating window that answers questions from your own documents during video calls, hidden from screen sharing, with on-device speech recognition.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • MP4Flow - Native FFmpeg front end for batch video-to-MP4 conversion, trimming, cropping, rotating, and merging.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Carbon - Menu bar app that transcribes meetings on device and saves each one as a Markdown file, with no bot and no cloud.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • AI Footprint - Read-only menu bar app that shows the disk space, background processes, MCP servers and login items AI coding tools leave on your Mac, with a receipt for every update.
  • Vortex - MacBook notch app with a focus timer, clipboard history, a file shelf that catches new builds, screen-to-task capture with OCR, and keys Claude Code can use without seeing them.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • RefreshYourMac - Mac cleaner that rates every category Safe to Remove, Review, Move to Backup or Protected, and shows what left it behind before anything is deleted.

Utilities / Window Management

  • Switch - Keyboard window switcher that lists every open window across Spaces and filters as you type.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • TimeMachineEjector (⭐1) - Menu bar app that ejects your Time Machine backup disk when a backup finishes and mounts it again when a scheduled backup is due.

16. Awesome Rust

Applications / Virtualization

  • terrarium-sh/terrarium (⭐52) - Portable minimal microVM sandbox for agents and development tools on Linux, macOS and Windows Terrarium

17. Awesome Testing

Software / API Testing

  • Bifurc (⭐4) - Local-first API client, mock server and traffic proxy for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a CLI for CI.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • bareenv (⭐0) - Runs a command once per environment combination (unset, empty, invalid) and reports the ones that break.

items.summary: 15 awesome list updated on Nov 02, 2026, including Awesome Smart Tv, Awesome Nextjs, Awesome Web Security, Tools, Awesome Developer First, Awesome Opentofu, Awesome Privacy, Awesome Polars, Awesome Selfhosted, ALL About RSS, Free for Dev, Awesome Gemini Cli, Awesome Mac, Awesome Rust, Awesome Testing
items.content_text:
#### [1. Awesome Smart Tv](/content/vitalets/awesome-smart-tv/README.md)

##### Android TV / Tools

*   [TV Box Tools (⭐18)](https://github.com/smartago/tvboxtools) - Launcher manager and ADB toolbox for Android TV and Google TV boxes: set the HOME app, kiosk, speed-up, display, remote, console, MCP server.

#### [2. Awesome Nextjs](/content/unicodeveloper/awesome-nextjs/README.md)

##### Boilerplates

*   [Midnight Lite (⭐0)](https://github.com/vilqor/midnight-lite) - Free dark landing page template for AI and SaaS products with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui. MIT licensed. [Demo](https://midnight-lite.vilqor.com)

#### [3. Awesome Web Security](/content/qazbnm456/awesome-web-security/README.md)

##### Fingerprint

*   [Passive OS Fingerprinting: TCP Fingerprint, p0f and JA4T](https://packet.guru/blog/passive-os-fingerprinting) - How the first TCP SYN gives away the operating system family, why a proxy shows up as a mismatch with the OS the browser reports, and how p0f and JA4T record the same packet. Written by [packet.guru](https://packet.guru/).

##### JWT

*   [How to revoke a JWT, from a system that does it](https://easinvy.com/notes/revoke-a-jwt) - A per-user revocation cut-off from a production multi-tenant app: why it compares against `auth_time` rather than `iat`, the whole-seconds rounding bug it shipped with, and the routes that trusted the token. Written by [Ridam Agrawal](https://ridamagrawal.com).

##### SSRF

*   [Instance Metadata Abuse](https://ransomleak.com/exercises/instance-metadata-abuse/) - Shows how a server-side request forgery bug becomes cloud credential theft through the instance metadata service, and why requiring IMDSv2 session tokens with a response hop limit in the instance configuration closes the whole class of forging bugs rather than one code path, by [RansomLeak](https://ransomleak.com/).

##### Scanning / Sub Domain Enumeration

*   [ONUS (⭐12)](https://github.com/maverickaayush/ONUS) - Web vulnerability assessment platform that orchestrates multiple scanners, applies deterministic CVSS v3.1 scoring, and provides AI-assisted vulnerability analysis and remediation guidance.
*   [Crossfyre Toolchain (⭐256)](https://github.com/clickswave/crossfyre-toolchain) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines in Rust for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting, injection testing and nuclei-style templates, with one CLI and newline-delimited JSON output by [@clickswave](https://github.com/clickswave).

##### Decompiler / Server-Side Request Forgery

*   [Wakaru (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/pionxzh/wakaru) - JavaScript decompiler that splits production bundles from webpack, esbuild, Browserify, and Metro into modules and turns minified and transpiled code back into readable JavaScript, without executing it, by [@pionxzh](https://github.com/pionxzh).

#### [4. Tools](/content/lvwzhen/tools/README.md)

##### Tools collection

*   [cv.cm](https://cv.cm/en/) - 110+ free tools that run in the browser: JSON formatter, Base64, hash, JWT decoder, regex tester, cron and timestamp converters, plus image resize/convert, PDF merge/split, QR codes and a few device tests (mic, keyboard). No sign-up, 8 languages.

#### [5. Awesome Developer First](/content/agamm/awesome-developer-first/README.md)

##### Browser Automation

*   [Browser Use](https://browser-use.com) - Python library for AI browser automation. Connect any LLM and run locally or self-hosted. [![browser-use](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/browser-use/browser-use?style=flat-square\&logo=github\&labelColor=%230D1117\&color=%23161B22)](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use)

#### [6. Awesome Opentofu](/content/virtualroot/awesome-opentofu/README.md)

##### Tools / Platforms

*   [Buddy](https://buddy.works) - Hosted CI/CD platform with native OpenTofu and Terraform plan, apply, and drift-detection actions, approval gates, and locked state storage.

#### [7. Awesome Privacy](/content/pluja/awesome-privacy/README.md)

##### Centralized

*   **[Signal](https://signal.org/)** - Messenger with end-to-end encryption for everything by default, run by a nonprofit that keeps almost no user data. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>
*   **[Threema](https://threema.com/en)** - Paid messenger from Switzerland that works without a phone number or email. <sub>AGPL-3.0</sub>

##### Third-party

*   **[Posteo](https://posteo.de/en)** - Ad-free email from Germany, funded only by its users, with optional encrypted storage and sign-up and payment that need no personal details.

##### Browser Addons / Anti-tracking

*   **[uBlock Origin (⭐69k)](https://github.com/gorhill/uBlock)** - Light, efficient ad and tracker blocker, in full only on Firefox since Chrome dropped Manifest V2 extensions. <sub>Browser · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Cloud Storage / Useful Tools

*   **[Filen](https://filen.io/)** - End-to-end encrypted cloud storage from Germany, with desktop, mobile and web clients you can inspect.

##### Other useful tools / Useful Tools

*   **[git-annex](https://git-annex.branchable.com/)** - Manages and syncs large files with git without storing their contents in git, across drives and many cloud and offline backends.

##### Shazam alternative clients / Deezer alternative clients

*   **[Audile (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/AudileTeam/Audile)** - Music recognition app that queries Shazam, AudD or ACRCloud and keeps your history on the device. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Desktop / Deezer alternative clients

*   **[qView (⭐3.7k)](https://github.com/jurplel/qView)** - Minimal, fast image viewer that shows just the image with no clutter. <sub>Linux · macOS · Windows · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Mario Kart / Deezer alternative clients

*   **[Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers](https://www.kartkrew.org/)** - Technical kart racer built on the Sonic Robo Blast 2 engine, the sequel to SRB2Kart. <sub>GPL-2.0</sub>

##### Minecraft / Deezer alternative clients

*   **[Cubyz (⭐3.8k)](https://github.com/PixelGuys/Cubyz)** - Voxel sandbox game with far view distances, 3D chunks and procedural crafting. <sub>GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Android SMS / Plugins for Minecraft

*   **[QUIK (⭐2.9k)](https://github.com/quik-sms/quik)** - SMS and MMS app, a maintained fork of QKSMS. <sub>Android · GPL-3.0</sub>

##### Android / Android-Based

*   **[LineageOS for microG](https://lineage.microg.org/)** - LineageOS builds that ship microG instead of Google Play Services, with F-Droid included.

##### IDEs / Other OS

*   **[GNU Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/)** - Extensible, self-documenting editor from the GNU Project that you can shape into a full IDE.

##### Automation / Apps and services

*   **[Huginn (⭐50k)](https://github.com/huginn/huginn)** - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act for you, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. <sub>self-host · MIT</sub>

#### [8. Awesome Polars](/content/ddotta/awesome-polars/README.md)

##### Polars plugins / Finance

*   [polars-talib-fast (⭐0)](https://github.com/meet-brad-ch/polars-talib-fast) - Every TA-Lib function (237) as a Polars expression, on TA-Lib's official Rust port, with TA-Lib's default parameters and output names by [@meet-brad-ch](https://github.com/meet-brad-ch).

##### Cheat Sheets / Miscellaneous

*   [Polars Cheat Sheet (CheatGrid)](https://www.cheatgrid.com/data-science/0597-polars-cheat-sheet) - A free Polars reference covering expressions, lazy vs eager execution, joins, window functions and streaming by [CheatGrid](https://www.cheatgrid.com/).

##### Tutorials & workshops / Miscellaneous

*   [U.S. bank analysis with Polars and DuckDB (⭐1)](https://github.com/anshuman-pandey/us-bank-data/blob/v0.2.0/notebooks/05_polars_duckdb_bank_data.ipynb) - A runnable notebook on lazy Parquet scans, validated identity joins, missing-value handling, and SQL reconciliation using a frozen FDIC bank dataset.

#### [9. Awesome Selfhosted](/content/awesome-selfhosted/awesome-selfhosted/README.md)

##### Software / Document Management - E-books

*   [Tome](https://tome.bndct.sh) - Ebook and manga library server with web reader, OPDS and metadata fetching. A KOReader plugin records every reading session and syncs positions both ways, powering streaks, pace, heatmaps and per-book stats. ([Source Code (⭐108)](https://github.com/bndct-devops/tome), [Clients (⭐108)](https://github.com/bndct-devops/tome/blob/main/docs/koreader-plugin.md)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`

##### Software / File Transfer - Object Storage & File Servers

*   [s3-orchestrator](https://s3-orchestrator.munchbox.cc) - Storage orchestration layer presenting many cloud providers as a single S3 endpoint, keeping N copies across them with read failover, plus optional per-backend byte, request, ingress and egress limits, zstd compression and envelope encryption. ([Source Code (⭐45)](https://github.com/afreidah/s3-orchestrator)) `MIT` `Go/Docker/deb/K8S`

##### Software / File Transfer - Peer-to-peer Filesharing

*   [DashBeam](https://dashbeam.net) - File transfer tool with peer-to-peer networking, letting you transfer any file with any size. ([Demo](https://app.dashbeam.net/), [Source Code (⭐10k)](https://github.com/tonyantony300/dashbeam)) `AGPL-3.0` `deb/Docker`

#### [10. ALL About RSS](/content/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/README.md)

##### Tech or IT / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

*   [RealMarketFeed](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/): a curated directory of trading news feeds (crypto, forex, stocks, macro), with an [OPML file](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/opml.xml) of every feed and a combined [feed](https://rss.realmarketapi.com/feed.xml) [![Open-Source Software](https://github.com/AboutRSS/ALL-about-RSS/raw/master/media/open-source.png)](https://github.com/Phideround/RealMarketFeed)

#### [11. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### Monitoring

*   [PingWise](https://pingwise.com/) - Quorum-based uptime monitoring, using 15 probes in 6 different continents. Pricing is credit based, offering 650,000 free checks per month (translates to 75 free monitors at 5-minute checks). No credit card, unlimited users.
*   [RealUptime](https://realuptime.io) - Uptime checks from 4 regions every 3 minutes, a public status page with 100 subscribers, and API, CLI, Terraform and MCP access. Free for 10 monitors, commercial use allowed, no card required.

##### Crash and Exception Handling

*   [RealUptime Errors](https://realuptime.io/errors) - Error tracking that works with Sentry SDKs. Free for 10,000 events a month with 14-day retention; past the cap, events are refused and counted, never billed.

##### Analytics, Events and Statistics

*   [Datasense](https://usedatasense.com/) - Web analytics with JavaScript error tracking, goals, and revenue attribution. Free plan: 1 site, 5,000 events per month.

##### Screenshot APIs

*   [Shotlane](https://shotlane.dev) - Screenshots, clean Markdown and PDFs of any web page, rendered in current Chrome. Hide cookie banners, ads and other popups and many more options. A free account gives you 100 credits per month, no card required.

#### [12. Awesome Gemini Cli](/content/Piebald-AI/awesome-gemini-cli/README.md)

##### Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

*   [Joxo](https://joxo.ai?utm_source=awesome-gemini-cli\&utm_medium=referral) - Shared project for a team's coding agents. Start Gemini CLI with `joxo gemini` and it works from the same task board, decisions and handoffs as teammates' Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents, and can ask a teammate's agent for help. Desktop app, iPhone app and a remote MCP server.

##### Commands & Extensions

*   [Ponder (⭐3)](https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder) - Gemini CLI extension and Agent Skill for multi-pass deliberation and code review: grades every file or document across 6 dimensions, runs four adversarial perspectives (skeptic, builder, dreamer, empath), and blocks early stopping until coverage reaches 1.00 and churn converges below 0.02 across two consecutive passes. Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with `gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder` or `npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli`.

##### Education & Study Tools

*   [mock-interview (⭐2)](https://github.com/georgesmomo/mock-interview) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (`npx skills add georgesmomo/mock-interview`). Runs a realistic mock job interview for any role, with research on the job and real follow-up questions, then gives an honest score out of 10 and a written report.

##### MCP Servers

*   [mach-gtm-mcp (⭐1)](https://github.com/verma6uc/mach-gtm-mcp) - Open-source MCP server with five outbound sales helpers for B2B teams: build an ICP, draft a cold email or LinkedIn message from a buying signal you provide, get a prospect research checklist, score a lead 0-100 against your ICP, and lay out a multi-touch sequence. Template-based; it looks nothing up and sends nothing. Works with Gemini CLI and any MCP client. Install: `npx -y github:verma6uc/mach-gtm-mcp`.

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/apoorvdarshan/coincide) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

##### Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

*   [Shutterbar (⭐1)](https://github.com/mucahitimre/Shutterbar) - ShareX-style screenshots with ⌘C-to-clipboard, after-capture tasks, last-region recapture and scrolling capture. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/mucahitimre/Shutterbar) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

##### Design and Product / Other Tools

[![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ixiehao/LumaView) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

*   [ShotMap](https://ixiehao.github.io/ShotMap/) - Turn videos into storyboard images with smart frame selection, manual refinement, and local PNG/JPG export. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/ixiehao/ShotMap) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

##### Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

*   [jdsp4mac (⭐1)](https://github.com/Tekkiech/jdsp4mac) - Menu bar app that runs JamesDSP audio effects, including EQ, AutoEQ, convolver, crossfeed and ViPER-DDC, on all system audio. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/Tekkiech/jdsp4mac) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

*   [Sidekey](https://wongsiufool.github.io/sidekey/) - Use your iPhone as a wireless keyboard, trackpad and voice input for your Mac or Windows PC over local Wi-Fi. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/wongsiufool/sidekey) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware")

*   [ShinyMac (⭐1)](https://github.com/pballada/shinyMac) - Open-source SwiftUI Mac cleaner with one-scan Smart Care, an app uninstaller that finds leftovers, Xcode cleanup, a Space Lens disk map and hidden settings. [![Open-Source Software](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-oss.svg "Open Source Software")](https://github.com/pballada/shinyMac) ![Freeware](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-free.svg "Freeware") ![Native App](https://jaywcjlove.github.io/sb/ico/min-native-app.svg "Native App")

A Rust port of CLIProxyAPI. [![CI](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/vayungodara/cliproxy-rs/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

##### Applications / System tools

##### Applications / Video

*   [0xS4N4TG/kinetograph (⭐440)](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph) - Programmatic video engine: a Skia and wgpu compositor, called from Node, that renders Remotion-style TypeScript and HTML to video without a browser. [![build badge](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph/actions/workflows/native.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/0xS4N4TG/kinetograph/actions/workflows/native.yml)

##### Libraries / Game development

*   [rornic/ochre (⭐51)](https://github.com/rornic/ochre) - A voxel world tech demo with a 64km erosion-carved terrain of rivers, lakes and seas, streamed with octree LODs out to 32km

#### [15. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md)

##### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [mendwright (⭐0)](https://github.com/saadbuilt/mendwright) - Self-healing selectors for Playwright and Selenium in Python. Repairs a broken selector from a saved fingerprint of the element, asks a model only when that isn't enough, checks the repair on the live page and can write it back into your code.

##### Software / Test Data Management

*   [Brume (⭐7)](https://github.com/brumeorg/Brume) - Copies a subset of a PostgreSQL database to a test environment, pseudonymizing personal data and keeping foreign keys valid.

Fingerprint

  • Passive OS Fingerprinting: TCP Fingerprint, p0f and JA4T - How the first TCP SYN gives away the operating system family, why a proxy shows up as a mismatch with the OS the browser reports, and how p0f and JA4T record the same packet. Written by packet.guru.

JWT

  • How to revoke a JWT, from a system that does it - A per-user revocation cut-off from a production multi-tenant app: why it compares against auth_time rather than iat, the whole-seconds rounding bug it shipped with, and the routes that trusted the token. Written by Ridam Agrawal.

SSRF

  • Instance Metadata Abuse - Shows how a server-side request forgery bug becomes cloud credential theft through the instance metadata service, and why requiring IMDSv2 session tokens with a response hop limit in the instance configuration closes the whole class of forging bugs rather than one code path, by RansomLeak.

Scanning / Sub Domain Enumeration

  • ONUS (⭐12) - Web vulnerability assessment platform that orchestrates multiple scanners, applies deterministic CVSS v3.1 scoring, and provides AI-assisted vulnerability analysis and remediation guidance.

  • Wakaru (⭐1.1k) - JavaScript decompiler that splits production bundles from webpack, esbuild, Browserify, and Metro into modules and turns minified and transpiled code back into readable JavaScript, without executing it, by @pionxzh.

Tools collection

Third-party

  • Posteo - Ad-free email from Germany, funded only by its users, with optional encrypted storage and sign-up and payment that need no personal details.

Other useful tools / Useful Tools

Shazam alternative clients / Deezer alternative clients

  • Audile (⭐1.4k) - Music recognition app that queries Shazam, AudD or ACRCloud and keeps your history on the device. Android · GPL-3.0

  • Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers - Technical kart racer built on the Sonic Robo Blast 2 engine, the sequel to SRB2Kart. GPL-2.0

Minecraft / Deezer alternative clients

  • Cubyz (⭐3.8k) - Voxel sandbox game with far view distances, 3D chunks and procedural crafting. GPL-3.0

Android SMS / Plugins for Minecraft

  • QUIK (⭐2.9k) - SMS and MMS app, a maintained fork of QKSMS. Android · GPL-3.0

Android / Android-Based

  • LineageOS for microG - LineageOS builds that ship microG instead of Google Play Services, with F-Droid included.

IDEs / Other OS

  • GNU Emacs - Extensible, self-documenting editor from the GNU Project that you can shape into a full IDE.

Automation / Apps and services

  • Huginn (⭐50k) - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act for you, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. self-host · MIT

8. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Finance

  • polars-talib-fast (⭐0) - Every TA-Lib function (237) as a Polars expression, on TA-Lib's official Rust port, with TA-Lib's default parameters and output names by @meet-brad-ch.

Cheat Sheets / Miscellaneous

  • Polars Cheat Sheet (CheatGrid) - A free Polars reference covering expressions, lazy vs eager execution, joins, window functions and streaming by CheatGrid.

Tutorials & workshops / Miscellaneous

  • U.S. bank analysis with Polars and DuckDB (⭐1) - A runnable notebook on lazy Parquet scans, validated identity joins, missing-value handling, and SQL reconciliation using a frozen FDIC bank dataset.

9. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Document Management - E-books

  • Tome - Ebook and manga library server with web reader, OPDS and metadata fetching. A KOReader plugin records every reading session and syncs positions both ways, powering streaks, pace, heatmaps and per-book stats. (Source Code (⭐108), Clients (⭐108)) AGPL-3.0 Docker

Software / File Transfer - Object Storage & File Servers

  • s3-orchestrator - Storage orchestration layer presenting many cloud providers as a single S3 endpoint, keeping N copies across them with read failover, plus optional per-backend byte, request, ingress and egress limits, zstd compression and envelope encryption. (Source Code (⭐45)) MIT Go/Docker/deb/K8S

Software / File Transfer - Peer-to-peer Filesharing

  • DashBeam - File transfer tool with peer-to-peer networking, letting you transfer any file with any size. (Demo, Source Code (⭐10k)) AGPL-3.0 deb/Docker

items.content_text:
#### [1. Awesome Iot](/content/HQarroum/awesome-iot/README.md)

##### Software / Miscellaneous

*   [Home Automation Cookbook](https://www.homeautomationcookbook.com/) - Free, tested smart home automation recipes with steps for Hubitat, SmartThings, Alexa, and Home Assistant.

#### [2. Awesome Fonts](/content/brabadu/awesome-fonts/README.md)

##### Free fonts / Fonts

*   [Geist](https://vercel.com/font) - Sans, Serif, Mono and Pixel font family from Vercel's Geist Design System

#### [3. Awesome Icons](/content/vkarampinis/awesome-icons/README.md)

##### Generic

*   [Hugeicons Animated](https://hugeicons-animated.com/) - Open-source, hand-animated Hugeicons for React built with Motion, installed icon by icon as source code with the shadcn CLI.

#### [4. Awesome Chatgpt Prompts](/content/f/awesome-chatgpt-prompts/README.md)

##### 🤖 Bots & Bot Teams

*   **[Bots](https://prompts.chat/bots)** — Share and discover bots (OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Grok Bot, and more). Each bot page has install instructions per platform, the computer it needs (**cloud**, **the user's computer**, or **both**), "Better together with" pairings, upvotes, comments, and change requests.
*   **[Bot Teams](https://prompts.chat/bots/teams)** — Groups of bots that hand work off to each other, shown as an interactive graph. Upvote a team or install every bot in it at once. Featured teams appear on the homepage, and **Teams** is in the top navigation.
*   **Profiles** — User profiles have Bots and Teams tabs with counts.
*   **Moderation** — Bots and teams can be unlisted to hide them from public listings.

#### [5. Awesome Machine Learning](/content/josephmisiti/awesome-machine-learning/README.md)

##### Python / General-Purpose Machine Learning

*   [GNN Fraud Ring Detection (⭐0)](https://github.com/RishabhPande/GNN-fraud-ring-detection) - GraphSAGE, GAT, GCN and GIN implemented from scratch in pure Python to detect synthetic fraud rings and money-mule chains.

#### [6. Static Analysis](/content/analysis-tools-dev/static-analysis/README.md)

##### Multiple languages / [Other](#other-1)

*   [Kin (⭐68)](https://github.com/kinlab-ai/kin) — A graph-native code repository for people and AI agents. Kin parses supported languages into code entities and their relationships (calls, references, imports, inheritance) and versions them with the source. The kin CLI and an MCP server query the same graph for callers, references, traces and what a change might affect. Imports existing Git history. Public beta.

#### [7. Awesome Docker](/content/veggiemonk/awesome-docker/README.md)

##### Building Images / Base Images

*   [nginx-lua (⭐228)](https://github.com/fabiocicerchia/nginx-lua) - Latest Nginx with LuaJIT on six base distros (Alma, Alpine, Amazon, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu).

##### Observability / Reverse Proxy

*   [groundcover](https://www.groundcover.com/) - :yen: Monitor Docker containers via an eBPF host sensor — logs, metrics, traces, and APM, deployed inside the user's own cloud (BYOC).
*   [metriclens (⭐2)](https://github.com/tyshkovskii/metriclens) - Auto-discovers Prometheus metrics endpoints across Docker Compose services and visualizes them in a local web UI.

##### Where to Start / Wrappers

*   [Docker Terminal Simulator](https://devops-daily.com/games/docker-terminal-simulator): Guided Docker lessons in a simulated terminal in the browser. Free and open source, no signup.

#### [8. Free for Dev](/content/ripienaar/free-for-dev/README.md)

##### APIs, Data, and ML

*   [DocSpring](https://docspring.com) - Fill out PDF forms, generate PDFs and Word documents, and collect e-signatures. Free developer plan includes unlimited test PDFs and 10 filled PDFs per month. Up to 10 templates, 2 users, and 2 integrations. No credit card required and no time limits.

##### Security and PKI

*   [CertAvert](https://certavert.com/monitoring) - Monitor SSL/TLS certificates on any port, checks expiry, chain problems, revocation, host mismatch. Monitor 15 domains free, get expiry notifications, email, Slack or Discord. No credit card required for signup.

##### Email

*   [mxRaven](https://mxraven.com/) - Programmable inbound email infrastructure with webhook, forward, and auto-reply routing, plus a durable pull-based event stream for consuming mail without a public endpoint. Free tier includes 1,000 outbound and 1,000 inbound tasks per month, 1 workspace, and 1 domain.

#### [9. Magictools](/content/ellisonleao/magictools/README.md)

##### Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

*   :free: [3DTexel](https://3dtexel.com/free-library/) - 1,600+ handmade CC0 assets: seamless PBR materials (incl. stylized), HDRIs, decals, 3D models and IES lights. A free account may be required for some downloads.

#### [10. Android Security Awesome](/content/ashishb/android-security-awesome/README.md)

##### Tools / Dynamic Analysis Tools

*   [Lab-RATS-v1.6 (⭐84)](https://github.com/K4N3CO/Lab-RATS-v1.6) - A lightweight Java-based Android Remote Administration Tool featuring a modern web interface for remote device interaction and administrative testing.

##### Tools / Misc Tools

*   [WPAForge (⭐142)](https://github.com/wlmosv-png/wpaforge) - Wi-Fi audit tool for rooted Android that builds candidates from the target SSID and hints and verifies each one against a real association; includes WPS PIN and split-halving attacks, LAN recon and offline `.cap`/`.hc22000` checks.

#### [11. Awesome Acg](/content/soruly/awesome-acg/README.md)

##### Uncategorized

*   [HairDeck (⭐404)](https://github.com/hyz317/HairDeck) - Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image. \[English/中文/日本語]

#### [12. Awesome Integration](/content/stn1slv/awesome-integration/README.md)

##### Projects / AI Gateway

*   [agentgateway (⭐5.8k) (⭐6k)](https://github.com/agentgateway/agentgateway) - An open-source data plane for agentic AI connectivity, providing security, observability, and governance for agent-to-tool (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication.
*   [Bifrost (⭐9.2k) (⭐9.2k)](https://github.com/maximhq/bifrost) - A high-performance AI gateway written in Go that unifies more than 20 model providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible API, with failover, load balancing, semantic caching, and governance.
*   [Envoy AI Gateway (⭐2.3k) (⭐2.4k)](https://github.com/envoyproxy/ai-gateway) - An open-source gateway built on Envoy Proxy to manage request traffic from application clients to GenAI services with unified API access and usage limits.
*   [IBM ContextForge (⭐4.7k) (⭐4.8k)](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge) - An AI gateway, registry, and proxy that federates MCP, A2A, and REST services behind a single endpoint with governance and observability.
*   [LiteLLM (⭐62k) (⭐62k)](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) - An LLM gateway that exposes 100+ model providers through a unified OpenAI-compatible API, with spend tracking, fallbacks, and rate limiting.

##### Projects / API Design

*   [Zally (⭐945) (⭐947)](https://github.com/zalando/zally) - Ensure the quality of your OpenAPI specs with this linter tool that provides extensive analysis and feedback.

##### Projects / API Documentation

  • capitol-cli (⭐0) - Free, open-source CLI that tracks U.S. House members' stock trades from official STOCK Act filings, with committee cross-references and late-filing flags.
  • govint (⭐0) - Free CLI that searches U.S. government records (SEC EDGAR, sanctions lists, USAspending, GLEIF, FEC, SAM.gov, FARA and more) for a company or person, links the results, and writes a sourced dossier.

Privacy and Encryption Tools / GitHub

  • Free Proxy List (⭐7k) - Free HTTP, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 proxies, tested and refreshed every 5 minutes, with lists by country. Useful for routing research traffic away from an investigator's own IP.

16. Awesome Neovim

Programming Languages Support / Diagnostics

  • dobsontom/dbt-ft.nvim (⭐3) - Jinja-aware filetype for dbt models, with Tree-sitter support for highlighting, folding, and indentation.

Programming Languages Support / Markdown and LaTeX

  • sammaji/markdown-preview.nvim (⭐37) - Preview Markdown files in your browser with support for math and diagrams, and synchronised scrolling.

Colorscheme / Markdown and LaTeX

  • heritage-themes/heritage-themes.nvim (⭐2) - [TS][LSP][L/D][Lua] A collection of 65 colorschemes drawn from the colour traditions of different cultures, with support for lualine.nvim and gitsigns.nvim.

17. Awesome Mac

Reading and Writing Tools / Markdown Tools

  • Splat (⭐4) - Native macOS Markdown editor in Rust where both the source and the live preview are editable.

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • tapflow - Self-hosted tool for testing iOS simulators and Android emulators from the browser, on Macs your team already owns.

Developer Tools / Virtualization

  • ContainerDesk (⭐5) - Native SwiftUI workspace for Apple's container runtime, with live resource monitoring and an integrated terminal.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Apolo - Open-source image optimizer that compresses and converts to WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, JPEG and PNG, showing the loss and its SSIMULACRA 2 score before saving.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Mudroom (⭐18) - Open-source app and CLI that runs coding agents like Claude Code and Codex in a Linux micro-VM on a copy-on-write clone of your project, then lets you review and apply their changes like a pull request.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • RAVE LIVE (⭐3) - Festival light show that locks to the beat of whatever your Mac is playing, with stage lights, lasers and MilkDrop presets.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Vauta - Open-source meeting notes app that transcribes any call on device, tells speakers apart and writes cited minutes with Apple Intelligence or your own local model server.

Utilities / Clipboard Tools

  • Clipivo - Local-first native clipboard manager that keeps your clipboard history searchable, organized, and private.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • AI Meter (⭐1) - Shows your remaining Claude Code or Codex usage and reset time in the menu bar.
  • Pulse (⭐33) - Menu bar system monitor with live CPU, memory, temperature, fan, network, disk, power, and battery stats.

Utilities / General Tools

  • AerialSwap (⭐2) - Turn any video into a native Aerial wallpaper for the lock screen and desktop, in its own group in System Settings.
  • Lucid - Live 4K wallpapers with moving space, nature and ocean loops on every display, plus Apple Aerials.
  • Uptick - Open-source app updater that finds updates from the App Store, Sparkle, Electron feeds and Homebrew, and verifies each download before installing.

Utilities / Productivity

  • Rebind - Open-source tool for remapping keys, mouse buttons and trackpad gestures to shortcuts and system actions.

Utilities / Window Management

  • Open Contexts - Open-source window switcher with a persistent app bar and saved window groups.
  • Show Desktop - Menu bar app that hides every window with one click or a shortcut, then brings them all back exactly as they were.

Utilities / Quality of Life Improvements

  • Safelight (⭐0) - Open-source menu bar app that schedules the color filter, brightness, and Light/Dark appearance, fading the screen to deep red at night.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • Mac Monitor (⭐7) - Lightweight menu bar monitor for RAM, CPU, network and disk, focused on memory pressure.
  • Matcha (⭐2) - Keep your Mac awake with a visual timer, a floating badge, and detection of AI coding agents.

Gaming Software / System Related Tools

  • Bedrock Launcher (⭐1) - Play your own copy of Minecraft Bedrock Edition for Windows on Apple Silicon, fully offline, through a locally built WineGDK with DXMT.

18. Awesome Rust

Applications / Finance

  • rsalianto/tradoor (⭐79) - Crypto trading terminal in the browser: candlestick, TPO and footprint charts, DOM, liquidations and a trading journal, drawn by a Rust engine in WebAssembly

Applications / Security tools

  • clickswave/crossfyre-toolchain (⭐256) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting and nuclei-compatible templates
