#### [12. Awesome Testing](/content/TheJambo/awesome-testing/README.md)

##### Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

*   [Oh My Android (⭐73)](https://github.com/ateymoori/oh-my-android) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
*   [AuditReady](https://feaefe371424d0725b266468856c9101.ctonew.app/) - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
*   [Barbwire](https://barbwire.ai) - Sends AI buyer personas built from your site through the live pages in a real browser, and reports where each one would stop buying, with a step-by-step replay, screenshots and fixes ranked worst first. 10 free runs, no card; paid plans from €49/month.
*   [RateMyApp Testing Brief Builder](https://ratemyapp.io/tools/app-testing-brief-builder/) - Free, no-account tool for writing mobile usability-testing tasks, expected outcomes, and feedback instructions.
*   [Site Spell Checker](https://sitespellchecker.com) - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

##### Software / API Testing

*   [API Spector](https://api-spector.dev) - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
*   [Openhook (⭐2)](https://github.com/openhook-dev/openhook-inbox) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
*   [SolidPing (⭐26)](https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.
*   [BestJSON JSON Diff](https://bestjson.com/json-diff) - Free browser tool for comparing saved JSON API responses by structure, with explicit array-order and record-ID matching rules.
*   [Kerno](https://kerno.io) - The AI Backend Runtime QA Engineer. Runs locally inside your coding agent's loop through MCP and tests each change against your running app and its real databases, queues and services.
*   [OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker](https://martingruner.com/tools/openapi-breaking-change-checker) - Free browser tool that compares two Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 descriptions (JSON or YAML) and sorts each change into likely breaking, review-needed or compatible; the files stay in the browser.

##### Software / Security Testing

*   [Darkmoon (⭐1.1k)](https://github.com/ASCIT31/Dark-Moon) - Open-source (GPLv3) autonomous AI penetration-testing CLI with 50 specialist agents and 140+ offensive tools over MCP for DAST-style web and API security assessment.

##### Software / AI & LLM Testing

*   [geokit-cli (⭐0)](https://github.com/gstar-byte/geokit-cli) - Open-source CLI for automated AI search engine readiness testing, `/llms.txt` validation, and crawler access audits.
*   [aiexpect (⭐2)](https://github.com/dmsehgal/aiexpect) - Python assertions for non-deterministic AI text that drop into pytest. Semantic and rule checks work offline; optional LLM judge with your own model; produces a Trust Score and a single-file HTML report.
*   [OrcaReplay (⭐398)](https://github.com/Continuum-AI-Corp/OrcaReplay) - Records a coding-agent session below the harness, keeping the verbatim request and response bytes, then replays the same run offline with the network off or forks it from a checkpoint onto other models with a verify command deciding the verdict.
*   [flight-recorder (⭐1)](https://github.com/xag/flight-recorder) - Record every nondeterministic input your code reads (LLM answers, HTTP, database, clock, randomness) as one JSONL tape per request, then replay the tape against the real code offline, bit for bit, with the first divergence named. Open format with Python, Node, .NET, Go, Java and PHP implementations.
*   [OrcaPromptVault (⭐80)](https://github.com/Continuum-AI-Corp/OrcaPromptVault) - Dated archive of the system prompts and tool-call schemas shipped AI agents send, so tests can be written against a product's real declared tool surface rather than a guess at it.
*   [fanout-check (⭐1)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/fanout-check) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

##### Software / Service Virtualization

*   [MockForge (⭐12)](https://github.com/SaaSy-Solutions/mockforge) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
*   [Twinbay](https://twinbay.ai) - Hosted, stateful twins of third-party APIs such as Shopify, Slack, Zendesk and QuickBooks for integration and AI agent tests. Each test run gets a private URL, and directives force states like rate limits or failed payments.
*   [fieldtwin](https://nickgeorgeai.com/fieldtwin) - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
*   [OutageFence (⭐0)](https://github.com/jn6825rsr7-afk/outagefence) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

##### Software / Visual Testing

*   [CurlShot](https://curlshot.com) - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
*   [cloneproof (⭐0)](https://github.com/pcjansen09-max/cloneproof) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

##### Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

*   [ai-wright (⭐1)](https://github.com/TestChimp/ai-wright) - Open-source library that adds AI action, assertion, and data extraction steps to Playwright tests, using annotated screenshots and your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key.
*   [blastproof](https://blastproof.dev) - Open-source AI agent that runs plain-English e2e tests in a real browser. It reads the pull request diff, runs only the tests for the pages that changed and can block the merge on a score. Runs locally or in CI with your own LLM key.
*   [Browser Use (⭐120k)](https://github.com/browser-use/browser-use) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
*   [cloudf.one](https://www.cloudf.one) - Rent a real Samsung Android phone in Singapore on a Singtel or M1 SIM and use it from a browser tab, to check how an app behaves for Singapore users. Manual use only, no Appium or scripts.
*   [Clousd](https://clousd.com) - Cloud Android phones (150+ device models, Android 12-17) for app testing in a browser tab, over ADB, or through a REST API and MCP server for AI-driven tests.
*   [ContextQA MCP](https://mcp.contextqa.com/docs) - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
*   [Device Hub Pro (⭐172)](https://github.com/gitemre/device-hub-pro) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
*   [Drengr](https://drengr.dev) - Mobile tests written as plain-English tasks instead of selectors, driven by an agent on real Android devices and iOS simulators. Works where there is no accessibility tree — canvas, games, Flutter without semantics labels — by falling back to vision and coordinates. Runs locally or in CI; bring your own model key.
*   [Drengr Runner (⭐1)](https://github.com/SharminSirajudeen/drengr-runner) - Drive an iOS simulator over HTTP from any language. A 479-line Swift XCTest target replacing WebDriverAgent on simulators. Apache-2.0.
*   [Proxy QA Browser (⭐1)](https://github.com/UbaidBinWaris/proxy_browser) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
*   [vibe-testing (⭐17)](https://github.com/AishwaryShrivastav/vibe-testing) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
*   [VibeView](https://vibeview.io/) - Run & test iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV apps right in your browser, with Roku in beta. Build tests by recording a flow or write steps in plain English, flows can be ran cross-platform, and wired into pull requests. When a step fails - AI agent takes over so the rest of the run still completes, and the report tells you what changed based on failed steps and visual diff.
*   [assay (⭐110)](https://github.com/awss1i/assay) - Deterministic command-line QA tool that serves a local web page, drives every control it finds in Chromium through Playwright. No tests to write and no LLM, with a Python API, an HTML report, and a plugin for AI coding agent. MIT, Python.
*   [Device Changer](https://deviceschanger.org) - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

##### Software / Test Report Diagnostics

*   [junit-collision-check (⭐0)](https://github.com/sunxiuguo/junit-collision-check) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

##### Software / Test Management

*   [qarunbook](https://qarunbook.com) - Free shared test runbook where testers record a pass or fail per platform with screenshots, and an issue marked fixed sends the check back for a retest.

##### Software / Test Data Management

*   [8½ Minute Mail](https://8m30mail.com/) - Receive-only temporary inbox for manual email verification testing, with an 8-minute-30-second default lifetime and no account required.
*   [TempMail Hub](https://tempmailhub.net/) - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
*   [Checklist kiểm thử Web tiếng Việt (⭐0)](https://github.com/qakit-vn/checklist-kiem-thu-web) - Vietnamese-language web form and login testing checklist with copy-paste Vietnamese test data (diacritics, NFC/NFD, +84 phone numbers).
*   [Mails.ai](https://mails.ai/docs/email-testing) - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
*   [mailsocket](https://mailsocket.app) - Inbox API that waits for an email OTP or magic link and returns it as JSON, with Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server.
*   [Personified (⭐1)](https://github.com/TheTechBasket/personified) - Free AI avatar photos of fictional people with typed personas (name, country, age band, mood) for seed data and placeholder users. MIT code, npm package.
*   [ARADURU File Format Test Corpus](https://teamaraduru-hub.github.io/araduru-file-format-test-corpus/) - Open CC0 corpus of deterministic healthy and intentionally broken XLSX, DOCX, PPTX, ZIP, and PDF fixtures with SHA-256 manifests for file validation, parser, upload, and QA testing.
*   [Código ao Ponto](https://codigoaoponto.com/en/tools) - Free browser-based test data generators and validators for Brazilian documents (CPF, CNPJ, RG, CNH) with valid check digits, plus test credit cards. No signup.
*   [postal-code-formats (⭐0)](https://github.com/vinceblock99/postal-code-formats) - Postal code formats, validation regexes and 9,000 real sample codes for 31 countries, with every regex tested against the samples in CI.
*   [ByteRivet Sample Files](https://byterivet.com/test-files/) - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
*   [StanzaAPI Test Data](https://stanzaapi.com/datasets) - Free CC0 synthetic test data for regulated B2B formats (IBAN, X12, ISO 20022, GS1, VAT, LEI, UDI, Peppol, Factur-X, CBAM, EPCIS), deterministic and check-digit-valid, as JSON and CSV.
*   [FormFiller test data tools](https://formfillerapp.com/tools/) - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22
    locales.

##### Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

*   [Keploy API Test Recorder](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/keploy-api-test-recorder/ohcclfkaidblnjnggclkiecgkpgldihe) - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.
*   [Spoof Me](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/spoof-me/onbjkmhileedchimkcmieeiomipdljki) - Test how a site behaves for users in other browsers, OSes, languages, timezones and screen sizes by switching the whole browser identity. Also available for Firefox.
*   [TabQA](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/tabqa/ddbodfcbakkoakaonpodnpgbkmmgpedp) - Connect, mirror, and control Android devices directly in Chrome via WebUSB without ADB; capture logs, inspect network requests, and record bug reproduction video buffers.

##### Software / Performance & Load Testing

*   [telegym (⭐5)](https://github.com/kolomiichenko/telegym) - Load testing for Telegram bots: a drop-in Bot API mock plus a k6 extension that drives virtual users.
*   [k6 (⭐32k)](https://github.com/grafana/k6) - Modern load testing tool, scriptable in JavaScript, with cloud and open-source options.
*   [JMeterHub](https://www.jmeterhub.com) - Interactive performance report visualizer for Apache JMeter logs with zero setup, AI conclusions, and shareable reports.
*   [Locust Kubernetes Operator (⭐93)](https://github.com/AbdelrhmanHamouda/locust-k8s-operator) - Run distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes with a LocustTest CRD.
*   [check-proxy-tax (⭐0)](https://github.com/600me/check-proxy-tax) - Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price.

##### Software / Test Automation Frameworks

*   [behave (⭐4)](https://github.com/emirmrkaljevic/behave) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.
*   [VeriSpec (⭐2)](https://github.com/godikemahesh/verispec) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

##### Software / Screen Recording & Session Replays

*   [Everframe](https://everframe.dev) - In-app bug reporter for mobile, web and TV apps that attaches an annotated screenshot, console, network, device info and an optional replay of the moments before the bug.

##### Software / Static Analysis

*   [SmartBench (⭐4)](https://github.com/xianyu-sheng/SmartBench) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

Also connects to Roblox Studio for scripts, assets and playtests, and builds FiveM / GTA V scenes.

Integrates with Unreal Engine and imports assets into Blender.

12. Awesome Testing

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Oh My Android (⭐73) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
  • AuditReady - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
  • Barbwire - Sends AI buyer personas built from your site through the live pages in a real browser, and reports where each one would stop buying, with a step-by-step replay, screenshots and fixes ranked worst first. 10 free runs, no card; paid plans from €49/month.
  • RateMyApp Testing Brief Builder - Free, no-account tool for writing mobile usability-testing tasks, expected outcomes, and feedback instructions.
  • Site Spell Checker - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

Software / API Testing

  • API Spector - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
  • Openhook (⭐2) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
  • SolidPing (⭐26) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.
  • BestJSON JSON Diff - Free browser tool for comparing saved JSON API responses by structure, with explicit array-order and record-ID matching rules.
  • Kerno - The AI Backend Runtime QA Engineer. Runs locally inside your coding agent's loop through MCP and tests each change against your running app and its real databases, queues and services.
  • OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker - Free browser tool that compares two Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 descriptions (JSON or YAML) and sorts each change into likely breaking, review-needed or compatible; the files stay in the browser.

Software / Security Testing

  • Darkmoon (⭐1.1k) - Open-source (GPLv3) autonomous AI penetration-testing CLI with 50 specialist agents and 140+ offensive tools over MCP for DAST-style web and API security assessment.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • geokit-cli (⭐0) - Open-source CLI for automated AI search engine readiness testing, /llms.txt validation, and crawler access audits.
  • aiexpect (⭐2) - Python assertions for non-deterministic AI text that drop into pytest. Semantic and rule checks work offline; optional LLM judge with your own model; produces a Trust Score and a single-file HTML report.
  • OrcaReplay (⭐398) - Records a coding-agent session below the harness, keeping the verbatim request and response bytes, then replays the same run offline with the network off or forks it from a checkpoint onto other models with a verify command deciding the verdict.
  • flight-recorder (⭐1) - Record every nondeterministic input your code reads (LLM answers, HTTP, database, clock, randomness) as one JSONL tape per request, then replay the tape against the real code offline, bit for bit, with the first divergence named. Open format with Python, Node, .NET, Go, Java and PHP implementations.
  • OrcaPromptVault (⭐80) - Dated archive of the system prompts and tool-call schemas shipped AI agents send, so tests can be written against a product's real declared tool surface rather than a guess at it.
  • fanout-check (⭐1) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

Software / Service Virtualization

  • MockForge (⭐12) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
  • Twinbay - Hosted, stateful twins of third-party APIs such as Shopify, Slack, Zendesk and QuickBooks for integration and AI agent tests. Each test run gets a private URL, and directives force states like rate limits or failed payments.
  • fieldtwin - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
  • OutageFence (⭐0) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

Software / Visual Testing

  • CurlShot - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
  • cloneproof (⭐0) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • ai-wright (⭐1) - Open-source library that adds AI action, assertion, and data extraction steps to Playwright tests, using annotated screenshots and your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key.
  • blastproof - Open-source AI agent that runs plain-English e2e tests in a real browser. It reads the pull request diff, runs only the tests for the pages that changed and can block the merge on a score. Runs locally or in CI with your own LLM key.
  • Browser Use (⭐120k) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
  • cloudf.one - Rent a real Samsung Android phone in Singapore on a Singtel or M1 SIM and use it from a browser tab, to check how an app behaves for Singapore users. Manual use only, no Appium or scripts.
  • Clousd - Cloud Android phones (150+ device models, Android 12-17) for app testing in a browser tab, over ADB, or through a REST API and MCP server for AI-driven tests.
  • ContextQA MCP - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
  • Device Hub Pro (⭐172) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
  • Drengr - Mobile tests written as plain-English tasks instead of selectors, driven by an agent on real Android devices and iOS simulators. Works where there is no accessibility tree — canvas, games, Flutter without semantics labels — by falling back to vision and coordinates. Runs locally or in CI; bring your own model key.
  • Drengr Runner (⭐1) - Drive an iOS simulator over HTTP from any language. A 479-line Swift XCTest target replacing WebDriverAgent on simulators. Apache-2.0.
  • Proxy QA Browser (⭐1) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
  • vibe-testing (⭐17) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
  • VibeView - Run & test iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV apps right in your browser, with Roku in beta. Build tests by recording a flow or write steps in plain English, flows can be ran cross-platform, and wired into pull requests. When a step fails - AI agent takes over so the rest of the run still completes, and the report tells you what changed based on failed steps and visual diff.
  • assay (⭐110) - Deterministic command-line QA tool that serves a local web page, drives every control it finds in Chromium through Playwright. No tests to write and no LLM, with a Python API, an HTML report, and a plugin for AI coding agent. MIT, Python.
  • Device Changer - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • junit-collision-check (⭐0) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

Software / Test Management

  • qarunbook - Free shared test runbook where testers record a pass or fail per platform with screenshots, and an issue marked fixed sends the check back for a retest.

Software / Test Data Management

  • 8½ Minute Mail - Receive-only temporary inbox for manual email verification testing, with an 8-minute-30-second default lifetime and no account required.
  • TempMail Hub - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
  • Checklist kiểm thử Web tiếng Việt (⭐0) - Vietnamese-language web form and login testing checklist with copy-paste Vietnamese test data (diacritics, NFC/NFD, +84 phone numbers).
  • Mails.ai - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
  • mailsocket - Inbox API that waits for an email OTP or magic link and returns it as JSON, with Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server.
  • Personified (⭐1) - Free AI avatar photos of fictional people with typed personas (name, country, age band, mood) for seed data and placeholder users. MIT code, npm package.
  • ARADURU File Format Test Corpus - Open CC0 corpus of deterministic healthy and intentionally broken XLSX, DOCX, PPTX, ZIP, and PDF fixtures with SHA-256 manifests for file validation, parser, upload, and QA testing.
  • Código ao Ponto - Free browser-based test data generators and validators for Brazilian documents (CPF, CNPJ, RG, CNH) with valid check digits, plus test credit cards. No signup.
  • postal-code-formats (⭐0) - Postal code formats, validation regexes and 9,000 real sample codes for 31 countries, with every regex tested against the samples in CI.
  • ByteRivet Sample Files - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
  • StanzaAPI Test Data - Free CC0 synthetic test data for regulated B2B formats (IBAN, X12, ISO 20022, GS1, VAT, LEI, UDI, Peppol, Factur-X, CBAM, EPCIS), deterministic and check-digit-valid, as JSON and CSV.
  • FormFiller test data tools - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22 locales.

Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

  • Keploy API Test Recorder - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.
  • Spoof Me - Test how a site behaves for users in other browsers, OSes, languages, timezones and screen sizes by switching the whole browser identity. Also available for Firefox.
  • TabQA - Connect, mirror, and control Android devices directly in Chrome via WebUSB without ADB; capture logs, inspect network requests, and record bug reproduction video buffers.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • telegym (⭐5) - Load testing for Telegram bots: a drop-in Bot API mock plus a k6 extension that drives virtual users.
  • k6 (⭐32k) - Modern load testing tool, scriptable in JavaScript, with cloud and open-source options.
  • JMeterHub - Interactive performance report visualizer for Apache JMeter logs with zero setup, AI conclusions, and shareable reports.
  • Locust Kubernetes Operator (⭐93) - Run distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes with a LocustTest CRD.
  • check-proxy-tax (⭐0) - Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • behave (⭐4) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.
  • VeriSpec (⭐2) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

Software / Screen Recording & Session Replays

  • Everframe - In-app bug reporter for mobile, web and TV apps that attaches an annotated screenshot, console, network, device info and an optional replay of the moments before the bug.

Software / Static Analysis

  • SmartBench (⭐4) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

Newsletters / Static Analysis

  • RoleGig QA & Testing - Weekly list of QA, test automation and SDET jobs in India, the US, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.

13. ALL About RSS

universally from / software release tracking

  • What's New : follows the changelogs of over a thousand software products. One feed per product, one for everything, with the release notes carried in content:encoded

Aggregators of Indieblogs / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

  • I ♥ RSS 1536: a member directory of RSS lovers, exportable as OPML

Podcast Feed Customization / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

  • ZeroAds: Ad-free versions of your podcasts as private RSS feeds; works with any podcast app.

14. Free for Dev

Tools for Teams and Collaboration

  • UserNote - A user feedback tool to capture most wanted features, free supports up to 50 feature ideas and unlimited votes.

15. Awesome Neovim

Split and Window / Tmux

  • minhyeoky/tmux-oil.nvim (⭐10) - Edit tmux sessions and windows as lines in a buffer, like oil.nvim.

16. Awesome Rust

Applications / Productivity

  • ipavlin98/traydex (⭐98) - Native drag-and-drop shelf for Windows built with GPUI: keep files, images, text and links at hand, or drop them on tiles to zip, convert, OCR and upload

Applications / Utilities

  • FortoGraphy/prism-download-manager (⭐126) - A cross-platform download manager built with Tauri that splits files into up to 32 parallel connections, with browser integration, video downloads, BitTorrent and crash-safe resume.

  • Off Hours - Amazon Ads dayparting, budget and bid rules for Seller Central and Vendor Central accounts in all regions. Rules run on the schedules and conditions you set, checked every 15 minutes. Flat $149 per month per Ads account. 14-day free trial.

8. Open Source Mac Os Apps

⏱️ Productivity (165) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • Earshot (⭐11) - Live on-device transcription of any app you pick, with speaker names in Microsoft Teams.

    Languages: Swift

    Screenshots

  • JoeBro (⭐91) - Native AI workspace with a local Python backend. Chat, documents, memory, MCP tools and deep research, using local models or any API.

    Languages: Swift Python

    Website: https://joexk1.github.io/joebro/

    Screenshots

  • Nogrammerly (⭐8) - On-device writing assistant that checks spelling, grammar and tone and rewrites text in any app, using Apple Intelligence.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/gaurabh-pei/nogrammerly (⭐8)

    Screenshots

⌨️ Keyboard (19) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • KeyEcho (⭐881) - Plays recorded mechanical keyboard sounds as you type.

    Languages: Rust TypeScript

    Website: https://keyecho.app

    Screenshots

📊 Menubar (177) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • Muster (⭐71) - Menu bar app that monitors Claude Code, Codex and Cursor sessions, answers Claude Code and Codex permission prompts from alerts, and switches sessions with Option-Tab.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://agentmuster.app

    Screenshots

👨‍💻 Development (62) / 📦 Git (25)

  • GithubStarsManager (⭐3.8k) - AI-powered, local-first app to organize your GitHub stars with auto-summaries, tags, semantic search, and release tracking.

    Languages: TypeScript

    Website: https://gsm.aminta.top

    Screenshots

👨‍💻 Development (62) / 🔧 Other Development (9)

  • JET Pilot (⭐663) - Open-source Kubernetes desktop client for working across clusters, namespaces and cloud accounts, with multi-cluster views, a resource graph, structured logs and a built-in kubectl terminal.

    Languages: Rust TypeScript vue

    Website: https://jet-pilot.app

    Screenshots

⬇️ Downloader (11) / 📱 iOS / macOS (46)

  • Arroxy (⭐792) - Video and audio downloader powered by yt-dlp, with a built-in browser, playlists, subtitles and download profiles.

    Languages: TypeScript

    Website: https://arroxy.com/

    Screenshots

🛠️ Utilities (235) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • Strata Files (⭐130) - Fast, keyboard-first file manager and Finder alternative with instant search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual pane.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://stratafiles.app

    Screenshots

  • Bulchimbeon (⭐47) - Menu bar app that keeps the Mac awake only while AI coding agents are working, with lid-closed mode and heat and battery safeguards.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/s3onghyun/bulchimbeon (⭐47)

    Screenshots

  • Clip’M (⭐8) - Clipboard manager with searchable history, previews, reusable snippets, and paste transformations.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://frazer.github.io/clipM/

    Screenshots

  • Kopi (⭐6) - Local-first clipboard manager with searchable history, pinboards and plain-text paste. Skips password manager copies.

    Languages: Rust TypeScript Swift

    Website: https://kopi.devanshuverma.in

    Screenshots

  • OpenClean (⭐38) - Free Mac cleaner that explains each item, quarantines what it removes for undo, and includes an app uninstaller, disk map and menu bar monitor.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://leoanimesh.github.io/OpenClean/

    Screenshots

⚙️ System (49) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • ftop (⭐374) - Floating system monitor for Apple Silicon that adapts its layout to any window size, showing per-core usage and frequency, GPU, memory pressure, and network.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://github.com/Nongfsq/ftop (⭐374)

    Screenshots

🪟 Window Management (28) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • LayoutKeeper (⭐23) - Remembers window layouts per external monitor and restores position, size and Space (macOS 26+) on reconnect, with DDC brightness keys on Apple Silicon.

    Languages: Swift

    Screenshots

📺 Terminal (30) / ✏️ Text (19)

  • Termstead (⭐17) - Native SSH client with a session tree, jump hosts, split panes and SFTP beside the terminal.

    Languages: Swift

    Website: https://khorenyan.com/termstead/

    Screenshots

9. Awesome Tensorflow Js

📖 Learn / 🤩 Powered by TensorFlow.js

  • TimeWarpScan.me - The viral Time Warp Scan filter, running 100% in the browser with your webcam. Slices webcam frames into tensors and stitches them back together. [repo (⭐9)]

10. Awesome Rails

Platforms / Other external resources

  • Light Cloud - PaaS that deploys Rails apps from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or a Dockerfile, with scale to zero and managed Postgres/MySQL on paid plans

11. Awesome Datascience

Tutorials

  • AgentFEM Simulation-to-Surrogate Mini-Lab - Compare raw and physics-informed features in a NumPy regression exercise using ten finite-element cases and a held-out split.

12. Awesome Cl

Shells, shells interfaces / Third-party APIs

  • cclsh (⭐24) - A system shell running inside Common Lisp. Ordinary Unix commands and Common Lisp forms share one live image, so the boundary between shell use and Lisp is small and explicit. ISC license.
    • for CCL on Linux x86-64, also SBCL on macOS and Linux.

13. Tools

Image compression

  • JFIF to JPG - Free JFIF to JPG/PNG converter that runs 100% in the browser, no uploads, no re-compression

Tools collection

  • Benchvale Base64 - Base64 encoder and decoder that runs in the browser, accepts the standard and URL-safe alphabets, re-adds missing padding, and ignores line breaks.

14. Awesome Mqtt

Brokers

  • Straum (⭐1) - Experimental clustered MQTT 3.1.1 and 5 broker that acknowledges a publish only after a majority of its nodes has committed it.

Cloud

  • ConnectMQ - Managed MQTT broker with MQTT 3.1.1 and 5.0, TLS, WebSockets and per-topic access control, no servers to run.

Tools

  • TopicBench (⭐4) - Free open-source multi-broker MQTT explorer and monitor desktop client, written in Rust.

Multi-Platform

  • TestMQTT - Free browser-based MQTT client for testing any broker over WebSockets: connect, subscribe, publish and debug topics with no install or sign-up.

15. Magictools

Communities / Voxel Editors

  • IndieGuild - Free hub where indie devs post roles and find composers, artists, programmers and other creators.

16. Urban and Regional Planning Resources

Platforms and Software Resources / Geospatial Data and Visualization

  • SquidMaps - A quick map making application that enables easy drawing, styling, and sharing.

17. ALL About RSS

XMPP (Jabber) / PubSub bots

  • Slixfeed
  • atomtopubsub (⭐20)

XMPP (Jabber) / Group chat bots

  • Morbot
  • feed-to-muc

XMPP (Jabber) / Private chat bots

  • JabRSS
  • JabRSS2

🔨 Blog Generator that Support RSS / Crypto or Blockchain relevant

  • Rivista

18. Free for Dev

APIs, Data, and ML

  • PolyDoc - REST API for HTML to PDF and screenshot generation. Including templates, PDF/A and PDF/UA output, privacy-focused, and more features. The free plan includes 150 conversions/month.

Email

  • AliasMail - Privacy-preserving email forwarding and alias service with HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks and custom alias handles. Free tier includes permanent email forwarding, custom aliases, and webhook integrations with no credit card required.
  • eForward - Email forwarding for custom domains. Free plan includes 1 domain, 1 mailbox, 10 aliases (catch-all ones count too), catch-all, and reply/send from your aliases (up to 5 new recipients a day). No credit card required.
  • FrostyVerify - Email verification, usable through a web app, a REST API and an MCP server + 1,000 Free Email verifications a month, no card

Forms

  • Formlane - Formlane is a form backend for static websites, site builders or AI-built apps. One endpoint gets email notifications with reply-to, spam-filtering without captcha and a CSV export. All submissions are stored in Frankfurt. Free Plan: 250 submissions/mo, no trial.

Design and UI

  • logoapi.sh - Company logo API with no key or signup, the ideal Clearbit logo API alternative with SVG logos for any domain. 2M free requests a month per site.

19. Awesome Python Typing

Dynamic type checkers

  • pydantic (⭐29k) - Data parsing using Python type hinting. Supports dataclasses.

Stub packages

  • boto3-stubs (⭐6) - Stubs for boto3 (⭐9.9k).
  • types-aiobotocore (⭐0) - Stubs for aiobotocore (⭐1.4k).

Additional types

  • annotated-types (⭐615) - Reusable constraint types to use with typing.Annotated.
  • annotated-doc (⭐82) - Document parameters, class attributes, return types, and variables inline, with typing.Annotated.

20. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

  • UI Verify (⭐25) - Visual testing for coding agents: your agent sees every UI change it makes, so visual bugs never reach production. Gemini CLI extension with 9 Agent Skills (set up visual regression tests for Storybook, Playwright and Vitest, keep captures deterministic, triage a build's changes) and the hosted UI Verify MCP server (15 tools) that shows the agent each change as a before and after against the baseline and lets it accept the intended ones. OAuth login in the browser, no API key in config. Skills are MIT; the service is hosted, free for 10,000 snapshots a month and 50,000 for open-source projects. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/uiverify/uiverify, then run /mcp auth uiverify.

MCP Servers

  • Model Salt (⭐2) - MCP server that gives the model randomness from outside it, so one prompt gives different pictures, stories, names and designs that still do what you asked. One tool, model_salt; add it with npx -y model-salt setup gemini. MIT.
  • Landed MCP (⭐4) - Hosted MCP server for job search in Gemini CLI: rank AI and tech jobs against a role brief, read application forms, and fetch interview prep. No key needed.
  • NeverApply - Hosted job-search MCP server for Gemini CLI: search and match jobs, tailor resumes, answer screening questions, prepare for interviews, and apply to jobs with your approval. Remote Streamable HTTP with OAuth sign-in, no API key; free plan available. Add with: gemini mcp add --transport http neverapply https://neverapply.co/mcp.

21. Awesome Game Remakes

Racing

  • OpenMCM2 (⭐0) - Motocross Madness 2 (2000) engine reimplementation in Rust for Windows, macOS and Linux; uses your own game files.

22. Awesome Mac

Design and Product / Screenshot Tools

  • Photon - Open-source screenshot, markup and screen recording tool for macOS and Windows, with no network code.

Design and Product / Other Tools

  • Anthora - Local photo and video library for browsing, searching, and reviewing duplicates across folders and mounted drives.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Yardlet - Open-source app for running Codex, Claude Code and other coding agent CLIs side by side in one window, using each agent's own sign-in and session history.

Voice-to-Text / Audio Record and Process

  • ParrotFlow - Local dictation app that you can program with your rules, scripts, and vocabulary.
  • Tamka - Open-source on-device dictation that runs NVIDIA Parakeet models on the Neural Engine and types at the cursor in any app.

Browsers / Audio Record and Process

  • Lilo - Native WebKit browser with Arc-style spaces, Chrome extensions, terminal tabs in the sidebar, and a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

Translation Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • SwaprTrans - Lightweight (<2MB) native menu bar tool for select-and-space translation and in-place Enter rewrite, powered by Apple's on-device model.
  • Tercana - Menu bar companion for PS5 Remote Play: live on-device subtitle translation into any language, plus a PSN trophy tracker.

Security Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Hey Mac - On-device face unlock for the lock screen and privacy shields for selected apps.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • Kipimo - Open-source menu bar system monitor with tools to clear caches, uninstall apps with their leftovers, find what fills the disk and review startup items, moving everything to the Trash.

23. Awesome Rust

Applications / Audio and Music

  • tsirysndr/music-player (⭐527) - Music player with Rockbox (⭐303)-powered audio playback, multiple interfaces, and streaming support

Applications / Image processing

  • heydeer/pngdeer (⭐242) - A lossy PNG compressor with automatic perceptual quality selection, available as a Rust CLI and WebAssembly app.

Applications / Productivity

  • emanuele-em/kanzo (⭐53) [kanzo] - Self-hosted kanban board for humans and coding agents: a web board and an MCP server in one binary, with data in a local SQLite folder

Libraries / Artificial Intelligence

  • infosave2007/cmf (⭐36) [cortiq-engine] - Single-file quantized LLM format (CMF) and inference runtime with no ML framework underneath: CPU, GPU via Vulkan/DX12/Metal, OpenAI-compatible server.

Libraries / Computation

  • oximo-rs/oximo (⭐106) [oximo] - Algebraic modeling library for linear, nonlinear, and mixed-integer optimization with multiple solver backends

Libraries / Cryptography

  • dsse (⭐0) [dsse] - DSSE (Dead Simple Signing Envelope) envelopes with PAE pre-authentication encoding: construction, signing and threshold verification, as used by in-toto and Sigstore attestations.

items.content_text:
#### [1. Game Datasets](/content/leomaurodesenv/game-datasets/README.md)

##### API

*   [unicum.gg](https://unicum.gg/docs) - World of Tanks player, clan, tank and map statistics across EU, NA and Asia, free and with no key. [Website](https://unicum.gg).

##### Dataset / Web

*   [OSTDB (⭐2)](https://github.com/OSTDB/soundtracks) - Official video game soundtracks (2,300+ albums for 1,800+ games) with Spotify, Apple Music and album.link URLs, as CSV, JSON and SQLite. [Website](https://ostdb.net), [API](https://ostdb.net/api).

#### [2. Awesome Appium](/content/SrinivasanTarget/awesome-appium/README.md)

##### Test Frameworks

*   [agent-qa (⭐911)](https://github.com/vostride/agent-qa) - Natural-language Android and iOS testing through Appium from vostride, with advanced memidex memory and self-improvement from verified runs.

#### [3. Awesome Webgl](/content/sjfricke/awesome-webgl/README.md)

##### Articles / Firefox Specific Tools/Debugger

*   [Building a Browser Solar System Explorer with NASA Data and Raw WebGL2](https://dev.to/wudao0123/building-a-browser-solar-system-explorer-with-nasa-data-and-raw-webgl2-5bkj) - Engineering case study on rendering the [Space Simulator Online](https://spacesimulator.online/) 3D Solar System, Milky Way, and 6,000+ NASA exoplanets at 60 FPS using raw WebGL 2 shaders without Three.js.

#### [4. Awesome Django](/content/wsvincent/awesome-django/README.md)

##### Third-Party Packages / Forms

*   [django-select2 (⭐206)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-select2) - Custom autocomplete fields for Django.

##### Third-Party Packages / Monitoring

*   [django-health-check (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-health-check) - Pluggable health checks for Django applications.

##### Third-Party Packages / Task Queues

*   [django-crontask (⭐127)](https://github.com/codingjoe/django-crontask) - Cron style scheduler for asynchronous tasks in Django.

#### [5. Awesome Webaudio](/content/notthetup/awesome-webaudio/README.md)

##### Packages / Frameworks

*   [Soundworks](https://soundworks.dev/) - Open-source creative coding framework for distributed applications based on Web technologies.

##### Packages / Libraries

*   [eko-web (⭐3)](https://github.com/reactivepixels/eko-web) - Web Audio playback engine for music players with gapless playback, crossfade, loudness normalization and React and Vue bindings.
*   [Bardkit (⭐0)](https://github.com/darkdarkcocoa/bardkit) - A sample-free plucked-string instrument for multiplayer games, with a four-voice pool and per-listener distance gain.

##### Packages / Utilities

*   [Audio Browser Lab (⭐0)](https://github.com/aribradshaw/audio-browser-lab) - Reproduce and diagnose browser audio playback, seeking, codec, and lifecycle bugs with shareable evidence.

##### Packages / Apps

*   [Database Inside a Song](https://blog.jasonsuhari.com/research/database-song/webaudio-demo.html) - Splits a stereo WAV, reconstructs its side channel, and visualizes the 18 kHz and 20 kHz carriers holding a byte-exact SQLite database.
*   [Tonecrafted Progressions](https://tonecrafted.com) - Free browser chord-progression player and ear-training tool for guitarists, no signup.
*   [Key Kalimba](https://keykalimba.netlify.app/) [Github (⭐10)](https://github.com/jonashuberts/KeyKalimba) - Interactive 17-key Kalimba trainer, falling notes visualizer, and real-time tuner with pitch detection.
*   [Melody Mate](https://melody-mate-khaki.vercel.app/) - In-browser generative MIDI workstation and melodic sketchpad using rule-based music theory heuristics and Web Audio API.
*   [Ocarina Simulator (⭐0)](https://github.com/zengm32343/ocarina-simulator) - A playable 3D ocarina with sampled and synthesized voices, breath-controlled dynamics from the microphone and song recognition. [Live demo](https://ootguide.com/ocarina/).
*   [Klaviero](https://klaviero.com/) - Falling-notes piano game for MIDI keyboards, built on Web MIDI and Web Audio (Tone.js), with in-browser audio to MIDI.
*   [psoup noise machine](https://psoup.art/machine/?utm_source=awesomewebaudio) - Free generative noise machine in the browser: brown, pink and white noise computed live with the Web Audio API, tuned by the moon and the day's earthquakes.
*   [seance](https://hexenwerkzeug.com/tools/seance) - Sample workbench on the Web Audio API: spectrogram, drum stem separation, hit-based slicing and BS.1770-4 loudness, all in the browser.

##### Resources / Tutorials

*   [Music Theory for Programmers](https://runjs.app/blog/music-theory-for-programmers) - Music theory derived from scratch in JavaScript, with runnable Web Audio examples.

#### [6. Awesome Playcanvas](/content/playcanvas/awesome-playcanvas/README.md)

##### Games / YouTube Playables

*   [Street Fighter Combo Challenge](https://www.youtube.com/playables/UgkxGF7ES_oNTQGaOOKydm_B80zczREKGCRB) - Test your skills by landing combos in this Street Fighter tie-in.

#### [7. Awesome Raspberry Pi](/content/thibmaek/awesome-raspberry-pi/README.md)

##### Tools

*   [nook (⭐0)](https://github.com/achevalier-dev/nook) - Turns a Pi into a shared folder and a network drive on your tailnet, both driven from another machine over SSH, with the disk offered over iSCSI or NBD.
*   [piscout (⭐2)](https://github.com/MilkteaTW1/piscout) - Windows desktop app that scans the LAN for Raspberry Pis, opens an SSH terminal and remote desktop, shows temperature and load of several Pis, uploads files by drag and drop, and flashes SD cards.

##### Projects

*   [Bad Thing of the Edge (⭐45)](https://github.com/Pakequis/Bad-Thing-of-the-Edge-keyboard) - Mechanical gaming keyboard for the left hand, built around a Raspberry Pi Pico.
*   [Cannvas (⭐4)](https://github.com/mikecann/cannvas) - Family touchscreen dashboard for a portrait TV with an infrared touch frame, with whiteboards, chores, calendar and Home Assistant controls, running on a Raspberry Pi 4 Model B.
*   [Clock/Calendar Retrofit (⭐10)](https://github.com/Pakequis/Clock_PiW) - Retrofits a broken electronic clock/calendar with a Raspberry Pi Pico W, synced over Wi-Fi via NTP.
*   [Coffee Edition (⭐0)](https://github.com/ierolsen/coffee-edition-kit) - A two-page newspaper printed every morning by a Raspberry Pi Pico W or Pico 2 W, written overnight by a Claude Code routine, checked by GitHub Actions and streamed to a network printer over IPP.
*   [MeshSat (⭐93)](https://github.com/meshsat/meshsat) - Off-grid messaging gateway that bridges Meshtastic LoRa, Iridium satellite, cellular SMS, APRS, ZigBee and BLE over a Reticulum routing layer, running as a Docker container on a Raspberry Pi.
*   [Raspberry Pi TV Simulator (⭐59)](https://github.com/Pakequis/Raspberry-pi-TV-sim) - Simulates a channel change with random video playback on an old tube TV, switching between static noise and composite video.
*   [Tiny Film Camera (⭐18)](https://github.com/SuveenE/tiny-film-camera) - Open-source digital camera with physical controls, film-inspired looks, a 3D-printed enclosure, and a phone-friendly gallery. Supports Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W.
*   [VoxRT](https://github.com/VoxRT) - On-device voice AI SDKs for Raspberry Pi, offering wake-word detection, VAD, keyword spotting, and streaming ASR, with a 100 KB wake-word model that runs at 5.3% CPU sustained on a Pi Zero 2 W.

##### Useful Apps / Android

*   **Mobile SSH** - SSH, SFTP, port-forwarding and multi-session terminal client for managing Raspberry Pis. [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.github.mobile_ssh), [iOS beta](https://testflight.apple.com/join/Ku4JtTEg).

#### [8. Open Source Flutter Apps](/content/tortuvshin/open-source-flutter-apps/README.md)

##### Productivity

*   [Daily You](https://openappscout.com/apps/daily_you/) - A private daily journal with moods, photos and Markdown notes, stored on your device with no account. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/Demizo/Daily_You))
*   [LocalMind](https://openappscout.com/apps/localmind/) - Chat with AI models offline on your phone or through your own Ollama or LM Studio server. ([Source (⭐305)](https://github.com/abdulmominsakib/localmind))
*   [StoryPad](https://openappscout.com/apps/storypad/) - A private diary app with a timeline, mood tags, photos, a PIN or biometric lock and optional Google Drive sync. ([Source (⭐994)](https://github.com/theachoem/storypad))
*   [Table Habit](https://openappscout.com/apps/mhabit/) - Habit tracker with growth-curve scores, local storage and WebDAV sync, for Android, iOS and desktop. ([Source (⭐1.7k)](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit))

##### Finance

*   [Cake Wallet](https://openappscout.com/apps/cake_wallet/) - A non-custodial wallet for Monero, Bitcoin, Ethereum and more, on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows and Linux. ([Source (⭐2k)](https://github.com/cake-tech/cake_wallet))
*   [Fingrom](https://openappscout.com/apps/app-finance/) - An ad-free personal finance app with multi-currency accounts, budgets and encrypted sync across devices. ([Source (⭐143)](https://github.com/lyskouski/app-finance))
*   [Invoice Ninja Admin Portal](https://openappscout.com/apps/admin-portal/) - Invoice Ninja's app for quotes, invoices, payments and time tracking on mobile, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐1.8k)](https://github.com/invoiceninja/admin-portal))
*   [Oinkoin](https://openappscout.com/apps/oinkoin/) - Offline, ad-free expense tracker for Android, Windows and Linux with budgets, charts and biometric lock. ([Source (⭐486)](https://github.com/emavgl/oinkoin))
*   [Peercoin Flutter](https://openappscout.com/apps/peercoin_flutter/) - Self-custodial Peercoin wallet for Android, iOS and the web, with seed phrase backup and testnet. ([Source (⭐32)](https://github.com/peercoin/peercoin_flutter))
*   [Sossoldi](https://openappscout.com/apps/sossoldi/) - A net worth and personal finance tracker for expenses, income and investments, on mobile, desktop and web. ([Source (⭐1.4k)](https://github.com/RIP-Comm/sossoldi))
*   [Waterfly III](https://openappscout.com/apps/waterfly-iii/) - An unofficial Android app for Firefly III to track accounts, budgets and bills from your phone. ([Source (⭐735)](https://github.com/dreautall/waterfly-iii))

##### Tools

*   [API Dash](https://openappscout.com/apps/apidash/) - A cross-platform API client for testing web APIs, with code generation for 20+ languages. ([Source (⭐3k)](https://github.com/foss42/apidash))
*   [Brethap](https://openappscout.com/apps/brethap/) - A breathing and meditation timer with custom breathing patterns, tones, vibration and a session log. ([Source (⭐86)](https://github.com/jithware/brethap))
*   [Glim](https://openappscout.com/apps/glim/) - A free Mac file viewer for Markdown, PDFs, images, JSON, CSV and code in one workspace. ([Source (⭐37)](https://github.com/NeoPanic/Glim))
*   [Onion Browser](https://openappscout.com/apps/onionbrowser/) - Private web browser for iPhone and iPad that routes your browsing through the Tor network. ([Source (⭐2.7k)](https://github.com/OnionBrowser/OnionBrowser))
*   [ServerBox](https://openappscout.com/apps/flutter_server_box/) - Monitor and manage your servers over SSH with live charts, a terminal and SFTP, on phone and desktop. ([Source (⭐9k)](https://github.com/lollipopkit/flutter_server_box))

##### Developer Tools

*   [iSH](https://openappscout.com/apps/ish/) - Run a Linux shell and command-line tools on your iPhone and iPad. ([Source (⭐21k)](https://github.com/ish-app/ish))
*   [Local Codex & Claude Analytics Ledger](https://openappscout.com/apps/codex-claude-analytics-ledger/) - See your Codex and Claude Code sessions, token usage and API-equivalent cost on a local dashboard. ([Source (⭐2)](https://github.com/imnakul/codex-analytics))
*   [Roxum IDE](https://openappscout.com/apps/roxum-ide/) - A code editor for Android phones with a file tree, terminal, code completion, Git and offline AI chat. ([Source (⭐666)](https://github.com/heckmon/roxum-ide))
*   [RustDesk](https://openappscout.com/apps/rustdesk/) - A self-hostable remote desktop app for screen sharing, file transfer and unattended access, like TeamViewer. ([Source (⭐128k)](https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk))

##### Communication

*   [Thunderbird for iOS](https://openappscout.com/apps/thunderbird-ios/) - Thunderbird's email app for iPhone and iPad, in early development. ([Source (⭐1.3k)](https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-ios))

##### Health and Fitness
